package datastar

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// defaultIndicatorSpinner is the inline spinner shown when Spinner is nil.
const defaultIndicatorSpinner = "inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent dark:border-blue-400 dark:border-t-transparent motion-reduce:animate-none"

// Indicator renders a loading indicator that shows/hides based on a Datastar
// indicator signal. Place data-indicator:<name> on the element that triggers
// a backend action, then render an Indicator wherever you want the spinner.
//
// This is the Datastar equivalent of htmx.LoadingIndicator.
//
//	<button data-on:click="@post('/save')" data-indicator:saving>Save</button>
//	@datastar.Indicator(datastar.IndicatorProps{Signal: "saving"})
//
// With a custom spinner:
//
//	@datastar.Indicator(datastar.IndicatorProps{
//	    Signal:  "saving",
//	    Spinner: feedback.Spinner(feedback.SpinnerProps{Size: feedback.SpinnerSM}),
//	})
templ Indicator(props IndicatorProps) {
	<div
		data-show={ indicatorSignalExpr(props.Signal) }
		class={ utils.Class("flex items-center justify-center", props.Class) }
		role="status"
		aria-live="polite"
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.Spinner != nil {
			@props.Spinner
		} else {
			<span class={ defaultIndicatorSpinner }></span>
		}
	</div>
}
package datastar

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// LiveRegion renders a container that auto-connects to an SSE endpoint and
// receives server-patched updates. This is the Datastar equivalent of
// htmx.PolledRegion — but instead of polling on an interval, the server pushes
// patches over a single long-lived connection.
//
// An empty URL degrades to a plain container (no data-init) — the runtime
// throws FetchNoUrlProvided for @get(''). Wire the stream via data-on:*
// on a trigger element instead.//
// The server endpoint must return a text/event-stream response. Use
// go-datastar (github.com/larsartmann/go-datastar) to patch elements or signals.
// Target a child element of the region with WithSelector — patch modes other
// than the default (outer) require one, and the default outer mode matches
// incoming root elements by their id (id-less fragments are dropped with a
// console warning):
//
//	func streamHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
//	    stream := sse.NewStream(w, r)
//	    defer func() { _ = stream.Close() }()
//	    resp := datastar.NewResponse(stream)
//	    _ = resp.PatchElementsTempl(metricsCardContent(),
//	        datastar.WithSelector("#metrics"), datastar.WithModeInner())
//	}
//
//	@datastar.LiveRegion(datastar.LiveRegionProps{
//	    URL:       "/stream/metrics",
//	    AutoStart: true,
//	}) {
//	    @display.StatCard(display.StatCardProps{
//	        BaseProps: utils.BaseProps{ID: "metrics"},
//	        Label:     "Active Users",
//	        Value:     "—",
//	    })
//	}
templ LiveRegion(props LiveRegionProps) {
	{{ live := livePolitenessValue(props.Live) }}
	{{ init := getActionExpr(props.URL, props.Retry, props.Cancellation) }}
	{{ hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(props.URL) != "" }}
	{{ autoStart := props.AutoStart && hasURL }}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		if autoStart {
			data-init={ init }
			aria-busy="true"
			data-tc-live-busy
		}
		aria-live={ string(live) }
		class={ utils.Class("", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
	</div>
	if autoStart {
		@liveRegionBusyScript(props.Nonce)
	}
}

// liveRegionBusyScript clears the aria-busy loading cue once the stream
// delivers its first patch (or fails terminally), so screen readers stop
// queueing and announce the live content. Singleton-guarded: safe across
// HTMX re-renders and multiple regions on one page.
//
// The datastar-fetch event also fires with the applied patch event names
// ("datastar-patch-elements"/"datastar-patch-signals") for successful SSE
// messages — that is the "first patch arrived" signal. Terminal failures
// clear the busy state too so the static region content stays readable
// (the global SSEErrorHandling handler announces the failure itself).
templ liveRegionBusyScript(nonce string) {
	<script { liveRegionBusyScriptAttrs(nonce)... }>
			(function() {
				'use strict';
				if (window.tcLiveBusyAttached) return;
				window.tcLiveBusyAttached = true;
				function tcClearLiveBusy() {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-live-busy]').forEach(function(el) {
						el.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
						el.removeAttribute('data-tc-live-busy');
					});
				}
				document.addEventListener('datastar-fetch', function(evt) {
					var type = (evt.detail || {}).type;
					if (type === 'datastar-patch-elements' || type === 'datastar-patch-signals' || type === 'error' || type === 'retries-failed') {
						tcClearLiveBusy();
					}
				});
			})();
		</script>
}

// liveRegionBusyScriptAttrs returns the nonce attribute for the busy
// script. An empty nonce emits NO attribute at all — rendering
// nonce="" breaks no-nonce and strict-CSP pages (issue #7), and the
// theme scripts follow the same omit-when-empty rule.
func liveRegionBusyScriptAttrs(nonce string) templ.Attributes {
	if nonce == "" {
		return nil
	}

	return templ.Attributes{"nonce": nonce}
}
package datastar

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// defaultLoadingButtonSpinner is the inline spinner shown when Spinner is nil
// (the same default as Indicator).
const defaultLoadingButtonSpinner = "inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-current border-t-transparent motion-reduce:animate-none"

// LoadingButton renders a button label that swaps to a busy state while the
// enclosing button's Datastar action is in flight — the Datastar equivalent
// of htmx.LoadingButton, driven entirely by the runtime's indicator signal
// (zero component-side JavaScript).
//
// The component renders CONTENT, not the button: place it inside a button
// that carries BOTH the action and the indicator marker, and pass the same
// signal name here. While the action is in flight the runtime sets the
// signal true (bundle-verified), data-show swaps the labels, and the signal
// clears when the response lands.
//
// Unlike the htmx twin there is no disabled-element mechanism in the
// Datastar dialect; gate double submissions server-side or via
// data-indicator-driven UI.
//
//	<button
//	    data-indicator:saving
//	    data-on:click="@post('/save', {contentType: 'form'})"
//	    class="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-white"
//	>
//	    @datastar.LoadingButton(datastar.LoadingButtonProps{
//	        Signal:      "saving",
//	        DefaultText: "Save",
//	        LoadingText: "Saving…",
//	    })
//	</button>
templ LoadingButton(props LoadingButtonProps) {
	<span
		class={ utils.Class("tc-btn-loading inline-flex items-center gap-2", props.Class) }
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<span data-show={ loadingButtonBusyExpr(props.Signal) } class="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
			<span class={ defaultLoadingButtonSpinner }></span>
			if props.LoadingText != "" {
				<span>{ props.LoadingText }</span>
			}
		</span>
		<span data-show={ loadingButtonRestExpr(props.Signal) }>{ props.DefaultText }</span>
	</span>
}
package datastar

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// PolledRegion renders a div that auto-refreshes its content via Datastar
// interval polling (data-on-interval). This is the Datastar twin of
// htmx.PolledRegion: the region fetches its own URL on an interval and the
// endpoint responds with a fragment whose root id matches the region id, so
// the runtime's default outer-mode patch replaces the region (self-patch).
// The runtime re-initializes the patched-in element, so polling continues
// with a fresh interval — and because this component never emits the
// leading flag, a self-patch CANNOT loop eagerly (leading + outer self-patch
// would refetch immediately forever; that combination stays out of the API
// on purpose — the same hazard class as htmx's forbidden "load, every"
// trigger on a self-replacing region).
//
// Initial content belongs in the children slot (server-rendered), so the
// region never shows an empty state and needs no eager-fetch mechanism.
//
// Polling busy state: the runtime wraps every tick in its fetching markers —
// attach data-indicator:<name> consumers via datastar.Indicator for spinners
// (see the Indicator docs). This component intentionally does not render
// aria-busy: there is no "waiting for first load" window to announce.
//
//	@datastar.PolledRegion(datastar.PolledRegionProps{
//	    BaseProps: utils.BaseProps{ID: "stats"},
//	    URL:       "/partials/stats",
//	    Every:     "10s",
//	}) {
//	    @display.StatCard(display.StatCardProps{Label: "Messages", Value: "1,234"})
//	}
templ PolledRegion(props PolledRegionProps) {
	{{
		live := livePolitenessValue(props.Live)
		nowFn := props.Now
		if nowFn == nil {
			nowFn = time.Now
		}
		updatedAt := nowFn()
		timeFormat := props.TimeFormat
		if timeFormat == "" {
			timeFormat = "15:04:05"
		}
	}}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		aria-live={ string(live) }
		{ polledRegionAttrs(props.URL, props.Every)... }
		class={ utils.Class("", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			role="region"
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
		if props.ShowTimestamp {
			<div class="mt-3 flex justify-end">
				<time
					class="text-xs tabular-nums text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
					datetime={ updatedAt.Format(time.RFC3339) }
				>
					Updated { updatedAt.Format(timeFormat) }
				</time>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}
package datastar

// SDKScript injects the Datastar runtime as an ES module. Include this once
// per page in your layout, alongside or instead of the HTMX script.
//
// Datastar loads as type="module" (deferred by default — no render-blocking).
// When loading from a CDN, a <link rel="preconnect"> to the CDN origin is
// emitted first so the module fetch skips DNS + TLS on the critical path.
//
//	@datastar.SDKScript(datastar.DefaultSDKScriptProps())
//
// Self-hosting:
//
//	@datastar.SDKScript(datastar.SDKScriptProps{Src: "/static/datastar.js", Nonce: nonce})
templ SDKScript(props SDKScriptProps) {
	{{
		origin := ""
		if props.Src == "" {
			origin = datastarCDNOrigin(props.CDN)
		}
	}}
	if origin != "" {
		<link rel="preconnect" href={ origin } crossorigin/>
	}
	if props.Nonce != "" {
		<script type="module" nonce={ props.Nonce } src={ scriptSrc(props) }></script>
	} else {
		<script type="module" src={ scriptSrc(props) }></script>
	}
}
package datastar

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// SSEErrorHandlingConfig configures global DataStar SSE error handling.
type SSEErrorHandlingConfig struct {
	// Nonce is the CSP nonce for the inline script.
	Nonce string
	// DurationMS is the toast auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds (default: 6000).
	DurationMS int
}

// DefaultSSEErrorHandlingConfig returns sensible defaults for SSE error handling.
func DefaultSSEErrorHandlingConfig() SSEErrorHandlingConfig {
	return SSEErrorHandlingConfig{
		DurationMS: 6000,
	}
}

func (c *SSEErrorHandlingConfig) normalize() {
	if c.DurationMS <= 0 {
		c.DurationMS = 6000
	}
}

// SSEErrorHandling renders a global listener for DataStar stream failures and
// surfaces them as accessible toasts so streaming errors are never silent.
// This is the DataStar counterpart to htmx.GlobalErrorHandling, which covers
// HTMX request errors.
//
// The DataStar runtime (v1.x) reports the fetch/SSE lifecycle on the
// document-level "datastar-fetch" event. detail.type is one of "started",
// "finished", "error", "retrying", or "retries-failed" (plus the applied
// patch event names for successful SSE messages). This handler reports the
// two terminal failure states:
//
//   - "error": the endpoint answered with an HTTP error (status >= 400).
//     Toasted with the status code from detail.argsRaw.status.
//   - "retries-failed": the connection dropped and automatic reconnection
//     exhausted its retries (default: 10 attempts, exponential backoff).
//     Toasted; the stream stays dead until its action re-runs.
//
// Transient "retrying" events are logged to the console only — the runtime
// keeps reconnecting on its own, and toasting each attempt would spam.
//
// Requires feedback.ToastContainer on the page for toast feedback (it provides
// the global tcShowToast function). Without it, errors are still logged to the
// console and announced via the aria-live region.
//
// Typical layout wiring:
//
//	@feedback.ToastContainer("")
//	@datastar.SSEErrorHandling(datastar.DefaultSSEErrorHandlingConfig())
templ SSEErrorHandling(cfg SSEErrorHandlingConfig) {
	{{ cfg.normalize() }}
	<div id="tc-datastar-announcer" aria-live="polite" class="sr-only"></div>
	<script { utils.ScriptAttrs(cfg.Nonce)... }>
		(function() {
			'use strict';
			var DURATION = {{ cfg.DurationMS }};
			function announce(text) {
				var announcer = document.getElementById('tc-datastar-announcer');
				if (announcer) announcer.textContent = text;
			}
			document.addEventListener('datastar-fetch', function(evt) {
				var detail = evt.detail || {};
				var args = detail.argsRaw || {};
				if (detail.type === 'error') {
					var status = args.status ? ' (HTTP ' + args.status + ')' : '';
					console.error('DataStar stream error:', detail);
					announce('Stream error' + status);
					if (typeof tcShowToast === 'function') {
						tcShowToast('The live stream endpoint returned an error' + status + '.', 'error', 'Stream Error', DURATION);
					}
				} else if (detail.type === 'retries-failed') {
					console.error('DataStar stream failed: retries exhausted', detail);
					announce('Live stream lost. Automatic reconnection failed.');
					if (typeof tcShowToast === 'function') {
						tcShowToast('The live stream was lost and automatic reconnection failed. Reload the page to resume.', 'error', 'Connection Lost', DURATION);
					}
				} else if (detail.type === 'retrying') {
					console.warn('DataStar stream interrupted, retrying...', detail);
				}
			});
		})();
	</script>
}
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/svg"
)

func ensureAccordionItemIDs(items []AccordionItem) []AccordionItem {
	for i := range items {
		if items[i].ID == "" {
			items[i].ID = utils.EnsureID("accordion", "")
		}
	}
	return items
}

// AccordionItem represents a single collapsible panel
type AccordionItem struct {
	ID      string
	Title   string
	Content templ.Component
	Open    bool
}

// AccordionProps configures an accordion component
type AccordionProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Items []AccordionItem
	// Exclusive, when true, renders every <details> with the same name
	// attribute — the platform's native exclusive disclosure group (Modern
	// Web Guidance: search-hidden-content, "mutually exclusive
	// disclosures"): opening one item closes the others, zero JS. The group
	// name derives from ID (or a generated one), so two accordions on the
	// same page never share a group. Engines without named details (older
	// Firefox) degrade to independent items — every item stays operable.
	Exclusive bool
}

// DefaultAccordionProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultAccordionProps() AccordionProps {
	return AccordionProps{}
}

// Accordion renders a collapsible accordion using native <details>/<summary>
// elements for zero-JS toggle, native keyboard support, and built-in
// accessibility (implicit aria-expanded, role=group).
//
//	@display.Accordion(display.AccordionProps{
//	   Items: []display.AccordionItem{
//	     {ID: "faq1", Title: "What is this?", Open: true},
//	     {ID: "faq2", Title: "How does it work?"},
//	   },
//	})
templ Accordion(props AccordionProps) {
	{{ items := ensureAccordionItemIDs(props.Items) }}
	{{ group := "" }}
	{{ if props.Exclusive {
		group = utils.EnsureID("accordion-group", props.ID)
	} }}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		for _, item := range items {
			<details
				data-tc-accordion
				class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900"
				if group != "" {
					name={ group }
				}
				if item.ID != "" {
					id={ item.ID }
				}
				if item.Open {
					open
				}
			>
				<summary
					class="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-4 py-4 text-start text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 dark:focus:ring-blue-400 focus:ring-inset cursor-pointer list-none"
				>
					<span>{ item.Title }</span>
					<svg
						data-tc-chevron
						class="h-5 w-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
						viewBox="0 0 20 20"
						fill="currentColor"
						aria-hidden="true"
					>
						<path fill-rule="evenodd" d={ svg.PathChevronDown } clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
					</svg>
				</summary>
				<div class="px-4 pb-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
					if item.Content != nil {
						@item.Content
					}
				</div>
			</details>
		}
	</div>
}
package display

// AreaChart renders a pure-SVG area chart with axes, gridlines, multi-series
// filled areas, optional dots, and a legend. Zero JavaScript — all rendering
// is server-side. Each series renders both a stroked line and a semi-transparent
// fill from the line down to the baseline.
//
//	@display.AreaChart(display.AreaChartProps{
//	    Series: []display.LineChartSeries{
//	        {Name: "Active Users", Values: []float64{120, 180, 250, 300, 280, 340}},
//	    },
//	    XAxisLabels: []string{"Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"},
//	})
templ AreaChart(props AreaChartProps) {
	{{
		width, height, style, emptyMsg := resolveLineAreaChartInputs(
			props.Width, props.Height, props.Style, props.EmptyMessage,
		)

		d := computeChartRenderData(
			width, height, props.Padding,
			props.Series, props.XAxisLabels,
			props.Min, props.Max,
			props.ShowGrid, props.ShowLegend,
			props.ValueFormat, emptyMsg,
			props.Class, props.AriaLabel, props.ID, props.Attrs,
			props.MaxTicks,
		)
	}}
	@lineAreaChartSVG(d, props.Series, style, chartSeriesRenderOpts{
		filled:      true,
		fillOpacity: areaChartFillOpacityStr(props.FillOpacity),
		showDots:    props.ShowDots,
	})
}
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/svg"
)

// AvatarSize defines the size of an avatar
type AvatarSize string

const (
	AvatarSizeXS AvatarSize = "xs"
	AvatarSizeSM AvatarSize = "sm"
	AvatarSizeMD AvatarSize = "md"
	AvatarSizeLG AvatarSize = "lg"
	AvatarSizeXL AvatarSize = "xl"
)

// AvatarShape defines the shape of an avatar
type AvatarShape string

const (
	AvatarShapeCircle AvatarShape = "circle"
	AvatarShapeSquare AvatarShape = "square"
)

// AvatarStatus represents the online status indicator for an avatar
type AvatarStatus string

const (
	AvatarStatusNone    AvatarStatus = ""
	AvatarStatusOnline  AvatarStatus = "online"
	AvatarStatusOffline AvatarStatus = "offline"
)

// AvatarProps configures an avatar component
type AvatarProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Src      string
	Alt      string
	Initials string
	Size     AvatarSize
	Shape    AvatarShape
	Status   AvatarStatus
}

// DefaultAvatarProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultAvatarProps() AvatarProps {
	return AvatarProps{
		Size:   AvatarSizeMD,
		Shape:  AvatarShapeCircle,
		Status: AvatarStatusNone,
	}
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup tables for avatar sizes
var avatarSizeLookup = map[AvatarSize]string{
	AvatarSizeXS: "h-6 w-6 text-xs",
	AvatarSizeSM: "h-8 w-8 text-sm",
	AvatarSizeLG: "h-12 w-12 text-lg",
	AvatarSizeXL: "h-14 w-14 text-xl",
}

var avatarDotSizeLookup = map[AvatarSize]string{
	AvatarSizeXS: "h-1.5 w-1.5",
	AvatarSizeSM: "h-2 w-2",
	AvatarSizeLG: "h-3 w-3",
	AvatarSizeXL: "h-3.5 w-3.5",
}

func avatarSizeClass(size AvatarSize) string {
	return utils.Lookup(avatarSizeLookup, size, "h-10 w-10 text-base")
}

func avatarDotSizeClass(size AvatarSize) string {
	return utils.Lookup(avatarDotSizeLookup, size, "h-2.5 w-2.5")
}

func avatarShapeClass(shape AvatarShape) string {
	if shape == AvatarShapeSquare {
		return "rounded-lg"
	}
	return "rounded-full"
}

// Avatar renders a user avatar with image, initials, or fallback
//
//	@display.Avatar(display.AvatarProps{Src: "/avatar.jpg", Alt: "Alice"})
templ Avatar(props AvatarProps) {
	if props.Src != "" {
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("relative inline-block", props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			<img
				src={ props.Src }
				alt={ props.Alt }
				class={ utils.Class("inline-block object-cover bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800", avatarSizeClass(props.Size), avatarShapeClass(props.Shape)) }
			/>
			if props.Status == AvatarStatusOnline || props.Status == AvatarStatusOffline {
				<span
					class={ "absolute bottom-0 inset-e-0 block rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-gray-900",
						avatarDotSizeClass(props.Size),
						templ.KV("bg-green-400 dark:bg-green-500", props.Status == AvatarStatusOnline),
						templ.KV("bg-gray-400 dark:bg-gray-500", props.Status == AvatarStatusOffline) }
					aria-hidden="true"
				></span>
			}
		</div>
	} else {
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("relative inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-accent-600 text-white dark:bg-accent-500 font-medium", avatarSizeClass(props.Size), avatarShapeClass(props.Shape), props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			if props.Initials != "" {
				{ props.Initials }
			} else {
				<svg class="h-1/2 w-1/2 text-accent-200" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
					<path d={ svg.PathAvatarFill }></path>
				</svg>
			}
			if props.Status == AvatarStatusOnline || props.Status == AvatarStatusOffline {
				<span
					class={ "absolute bottom-0 inset-e-0 block rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-gray-900",
						avatarDotSizeClass(props.Size),
						templ.KV("bg-green-400 dark:bg-green-500", props.Status == AvatarStatusOnline),
						templ.KV("bg-gray-400 dark:bg-gray-500", props.Status == AvatarStatusOffline) }
					aria-hidden="true"
				></span>
			}
		</div>
	}
}
package display

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// BadgeType defines the visual style of a badge
type BadgeType string

const (
	BadgePrimary BadgeType = "primary"
	BadgeSuccess BadgeType = "success"
	BadgeWarning BadgeType = "warning"
	BadgeError   BadgeType = "error"
	BadgeInfo    BadgeType = "info"
	BadgeNeutral BadgeType = "neutral"
)

// BadgeSize defines the size of a badge
type BadgeSize string

const (
	BadgeSizeSM BadgeSize = "sm"
	BadgeSizeMD BadgeSize = "md"
	BadgeSizeLG BadgeSize = "lg"
)

// BadgeProps configures a status badge
type BadgeProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Text string
	Type BadgeType
	Size BadgeSize
	Pill bool
	Dot  bool
	Href string
}

// DefaultBadgeProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultBadgeProps() BadgeProps {
	return BadgeProps{
		Type: BadgeNeutral,
		Size: BadgeSizeMD,
	}
}

// Badge renders a compact status label
//
//	@display.Badge(display.BadgeProps{Text: "Active", Type: display.BadgeSuccess, Dot: true})
templ Badge(props BadgeProps) {
	if props.Href != "" {
		<a
			href={ templ.SafeURL(props.Href) }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("inline-flex items-center font-medium", badgeSizeClass(props.Size), badgeShapeClass(props.Pill), badgeColorClass(props.Type), props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			@badgeContent(props)
		</a>
	} else {
		<span
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("inline-flex items-center font-medium", badgeSizeClass(props.Size), badgeShapeClass(props.Pill), badgeColorClass(props.Type), props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			@badgeContent(props)
		</span>
	}
}

// badgeContent renders the optional dot followed by the label. The dot and the
// label share ONE source line on purpose: a newline between them emits a
// literal space into the text content, so copied badge text started with a
// space and the gap no longer came from the me-1.5 utility alone.
templ badgeContent(props BadgeProps) {
	if props.Dot {
		<span class={ "me-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full", badgeDotColorClass(props.Type) } aria-hidden="true"></span>{ props.Text }
	} else {
		{ props.Text }
	}
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for badge sizes
var badgeSizeLookup = map[BadgeSize]string{
	BadgeSizeSM: "px-2 py-0.5 text-xs",
	BadgeSizeMD: "px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs",
	BadgeSizeLG: "px-3 py-1 text-sm",
}

func badgeSizeClass(s BadgeSize) string {
	return utils.Lookup(badgeSizeLookup, s, badgeSizeLookup[BadgeSizeMD])
}

func badgeShapeClass(pill bool) string {
	if pill {
		return "rounded-full"
	}
	return "rounded-md"
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for badge styles
type badgeStyle struct {
	BG  string
	Dot string
}

var badgeStyleMap = map[BadgeType]badgeStyle{
	BadgePrimary: {"bg-accent-100 text-accent-800 dark:bg-accent-900/30 dark:text-accent-300", "bg-accent-500"},
	BadgeSuccess: {"bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300", "bg-green-500"},
	BadgeWarning: {"bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-300", "bg-amber-500"},
	BadgeError:   {"bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300", "bg-red-500"},
	BadgeInfo:    {"bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300", "bg-blue-500"},
	BadgeNeutral: {"bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300", "bg-gray-500"},
}

func badgeLookupStyle(t BadgeType) badgeStyle {
	return utils.Lookup(badgeStyleMap, t, badgeStyleMap[BadgeNeutral])
}

func badgeColorClass(t BadgeType) string    { return badgeLookupStyle(t).BG }
func badgeDotColorClass(t BadgeType) string { return badgeLookupStyle(t).Dot }

// StatusBadge is a convenience wrapper for common status values
// Maps status strings to badge types automatically
//
//	@display.StatusBadge("active")
templ StatusBadge(status string) {
	{{ mapped := MapStatusToBadgeType(status) }}
	@Badge(BadgeProps{Text: status, Type: mapped, Dot: true})
}

// StatusBadgeMapper maps a consumer status string to a badge type. Return
// the zero value ("" — rendered neutral) for unknown statuses; mappers that
// want the built-in mapping for unhandled values can call
// MapStatusToBadgeType.
type StatusBadgeMapper func(status string) BadgeType

// MapStatusToBadgeType maps a status string to a badge type — the built-in
// mapping behind StatusBadge, exposed for consumer mappers that extend
// rather than replace it (dnsblockd carries four local mappers — the
// extraction demand behind StatusBadgeWith).
func MapStatusToBadgeType(status string) BadgeType {
	return utils.Lookup(statusToBadgeMap, strings.ToLower(status), BadgeNeutral)
}

// resolveStatusBadgeType applies the consumer mapper when set, else the
// built-in mapping.
func resolveStatusBadgeType(mapper StatusBadgeMapper, status string) BadgeType {
	if mapper != nil {
		return mapper(status)
	}

	return MapStatusToBadgeType(status)
}

// StatusBadgeWith renders a StatusBadge through a consumer-supplied mapper —
// inject your domain's status vocabulary (e.g. dnsblockd's allow/block
// states) without forking the component. A nil mapper falls back to the
// built-in mapping (identical to StatusBadge).
//
//	@display.StatusBadgeWith(func(s string) display.BadgeType {
//		if s == "blocked" { return display.BadgeError }
//		return display.MapStatusToBadgeType(s)
//	}, row.Status)
templ StatusBadgeWith(mapper StatusBadgeMapper, status string) {
	{{ badgeType := resolveStatusBadgeType(mapper, status) }}
	@Badge(BadgeProps{Text: status, Type: badgeType, Dot: true})
}

var statusToBadgeMap = map[string]BadgeType{
	"active": BadgeSuccess, "healthy": BadgeSuccess, "success": BadgeSuccess,
	"completed": BadgeSuccess, "done": BadgeSuccess, "passed": BadgeSuccess, "green": BadgeSuccess,
	"pending": BadgeWarning, "warning": BadgeWarning, "degraded": BadgeWarning,
	"yellow": BadgeWarning, "in_progress": BadgeWarning,
	"error": BadgeError, "failed": BadgeError, "critical": BadgeError,
	"unhealthy": BadgeError, "red": BadgeError, "down": BadgeError,
	"info": BadgeInfo, "blue": BadgeInfo, "running": BadgeInfo,
	"primary": BadgePrimary, "default": BadgeNeutral,
}

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// BarChart renders a CSS-based bar chart — no JavaScript, no SVG.
// Horizontal orientation shows label bars; vertical shows columns.
// The chart is responsive and dark-mode aware.
//
//	@display.BarChart(display.BarChartProps{
//	   Bars: []display.BarChartBar{
//	       {Label: "general", Value: 1200},
//	       {Label: "random", Value: 800},
//	       {Label: "dev", Value: 450},
//	   },
//	})
templ BarChart(props BarChartProps) {
	{{
		bars := props.Bars
		orient := props.Orient
		if !BarOrientIsValid(orient) {
			orient = BarHorizontal
		}
		barColor := string(props.BarColor)
		if barColor == "" {
			barColor = "bg-accent-600 dark:bg-accent-500"
		}
		labelWidth := props.LabelWidth
		if labelWidth == "" {
			labelWidth = "w-32"
		}
		emptyMsg := props.EmptyMessage
		if emptyMsg == "" {
			emptyMsg = "No data"
		}
		valueFmt := props.ValueFormat
		if valueFmt == nil {
			valueFmt = func(v float64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%.0f", v) }
		}
		maxVal, minVal := barChartBounds(bars, props.Max)
		hasNegative := minVal < 0
		minBarW := props.MinBarWidth
		if minBarW == "" {
			minBarW = defaultMinBarWidth
		}
		gapClass := props.Gap
		if gapClass == "" {
			gapClass = defaultVerticalGap
		}
	}}
	if len(bars) == 0 {
		<p
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400", props.Class) }
		>{ emptyMsg }</p>
	} else if orient == BarVertical {
		{{
			heightVal := props.Height
			if heightVal == "" {
				heightVal = defaultVerticalHeight
			}

			negColor := string(props.NegativeBarColor)
			if negColor == "" {
				negColor = defaultNegativeBarColor
			}
		}}
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("flex overflow-x-auto", gapClass, utils.Ternary(props.MaxBarWidth != "", "justify-center", ""), props.Class) }
			style={ "height:" + heightVal }
			role="img"
			aria-label={ utils.Coalesce(props.AriaLabel, barChartFallbackName) }
		>
			for _, bar := range bars {
				{{ zeroPct, barTopPct, heightPct, negative := barChartSignedPlacement(bar.Value, maxVal, minVal) }}
				<div
					class={ utils.Class("flex h-full w-full flex-col items-center gap-1", minBarW, props.MaxBarWidth) }
					if bar.Tooltip != "" {
						title={ bar.Tooltip }
					}
				>
					<div class="relative w-full flex-1">
						if props.ShowBaseline || hasNegative {
							<div class="absolute inset-x-0 h-px bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700" style={ "bottom:" + zeroPct }></div>
						}
						if negative {
							if props.ShowValues {
								<span class="absolute inset-x-0 text-center text-xs tabular-nums text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" style={ "top:calc(" + barTopPct + " + " + heightPct + ")" }>{ barValueLabel(bar, valueFmt) }</span>
							}
							<div class={ utils.Class("absolute inset-x-0 rounded-b", negColor, string(bar.Color)) } style={ "top:" + barTopPct + ";height:" + heightPct }></div>
						} else {
							if props.ShowValues {
								<span class="absolute inset-x-0 text-center text-xs tabular-nums text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" style={ "bottom:calc(" + zeroPct + " + " + heightPct + ")" }>{ barValueLabel(bar, valueFmt) }</span>
							}
							<div class={ utils.Class("absolute inset-x-0 rounded-t", barColor, string(bar.Color)) } style={ "bottom:" + zeroPct + ";height:" + heightPct }></div>
						}
					</div>
					<span class="w-full truncate text-center text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" title={ bar.Label }>
						{ truncateLabel(bar.Label, 12) }
					</span>
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	} else {
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("space-y-2", props.Class) }
			role="img"
			aria-label={ utils.Coalesce(props.AriaLabel, barChartFallbackName) }
		>
			for _, bar := range bars {
				<div
					class="flex items-center gap-3"
					if bar.Tooltip != "" {
						title={ bar.Tooltip }
					}
				>
					if bar.Href != "" {
						<a
							href={ templ.SafeURL(bar.Href) }
							class={ utils.Class("shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-accent-600 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:text-accent-400", labelWidth) }
							title={ bar.Label }
						>
							{ truncateLabel(bar.Label, 22) }
						</a>
					} else {
						<span class={ utils.Class("shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300", labelWidth) } title={ bar.Label }>
							{ truncateLabel(bar.Label, 22) }
						</span>
					}
					<div class="flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800">
						<div
							class={ utils.Class("h-5 rounded bg-accent-600 dark:bg-accent-500", barColor, string(bar.Color)) }
							style={ "width:" + barPercentWidth(bar.Value, maxVal) }
						></div>
					</div>
					if props.ShowValues {
						<span class="w-16 shrink-0 text-end text-xs tabular-nums text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
							{ barValueLabel(bar, valueFmt) }
						</span>
					}
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	}
}

// truncateLabel truncates a string to maxLen runes with an ellipsis. Trimming
// runes (not bytes) keeps multibyte labels valid UTF-8 — a byte cut split
// characters in half and rendered mojibake for international labels.
func truncateLabel(s string, maxLen int) string {
	runes := []rune(s)
	if len(runes) <= maxLen {
		return s
	}
	return string(runes[:maxLen-1]) + "…"
}
package display

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// buttonContent renders the element's inner markup: the consumer Children
// slot when set, otherwise Icon + Text.
templ buttonContent(props ButtonProps) {
	if props.Children != nil {
		@props.Children
	} else {
		if props.Icon != nil {
			@props.Icon
		}{ props.Text }
	}
}

// Button renders a button or link styled as a button.
// When Href is set, renders as an anchor tag; otherwise renders as a button element.
//
//	@display.Button(display.DefaultButtonProps())
//	@display.Button(display.ButtonProps{Text: "Save", Type: display.ButtonHTMLSubmit})
//	@display.Button(display.ButtonProps{Text: "Docs", Href: "/docs", Variant: display.ButtonSecondary})
templ Button(props ButtonProps) {
	{{
		classes := utils.Class(
			buttonBaseClass,
			buttonVariantClasses(props.Variant),
			buttonSizeClasses(props.Size),
			props.Class,
		)
	}}
	if props.Href != "" {
		<a
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			href={ templ.SafeURL(props.Href) }
			class={ utils.Class(classes, utils.Ternary(props.Disabled, "pointer-events-none opacity-50", "")) }
			if props.Disabled {
				aria-disabled="true"
				tabindex="-1"
			}
			if props.External {
				target="_blank"
				rel="noopener noreferrer"
			}
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			if props.Wire != nil {
				{ props.Wire.Attributes()... }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>@buttonContent(props)</a>
	} else {
		<button
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			type={ buttonHTMLType(props.Type) }
			class={ classes }
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			if props.Wire != nil {
				{ props.Wire.Attributes()... }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>@buttonContent(props)</button>
	}
}
package display

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/htmx"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/svg"
)

const cardShellClass = "bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-xs print:shadow-none print:border-0 print:bg-transparent"

// CardPadding defines the internal padding of a card
type CardPadding string

const (
	CardPaddingNone CardPadding = "none"
	CardPaddingSM   CardPadding = "sm"
	CardPaddingMD   CardPadding = "md"
	CardPaddingLG   CardPadding = "lg"
)

// CardProps configures a card container.
//
// Corners are SHARP by default. Restore rounding per card via Class
// ("rounded-lg") or apply the iOS-style continuous curve with
// Class: "rounded-lg tc-squircle" (progressive enhancement — browsers
// without CSS corner-shape render the plain rounded corners).
//
// Set ContainerAware: true to make padding adapt to the card's parent
// container width (CSS @container) instead of the viewport. Useful when Card
// is placed inside a sidebar, grid cell, or other constrained layout. See
// ADR-0018.
type CardProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Title        string
	Subtitle     string
	Footer       templ.Component
	HeaderAction templ.Component
	// Header, when set, replaces the entire default header section (title,
	// subtitle, header action). Use this for custom header layouts that the
	// Title/Subtitle/HeaderAction fields can't express. When nil, the default
	// header renders if Title or HeaderAction is set.
	Header templ.Component
	// Body, when set, overrides children for the card's main content area.
	// Use this for struct-based composition; pass children for templ-block
	// composition. If both are set, Body takes precedence.
	Body    templ.Component
	Padding CardPadding
	// TitleTag overrides the heading element for the card title.
	// Defaults to h3 (HeadingTagH3) when empty. Set to HeadingTagH2 when the
	// card is the first heading level after a page <h1> to maintain correct
	// heading order for screen-reader navigation.
	TitleTag HeadingTagType
	// TitleClass, when set, overrides the default <h3> title classes. Consumer
	// classes are merged LAST so they win via tailwind-merge.
	TitleClass string
	// HeaderClass, when set, overrides the default header wrapper classes.
	// Consumer classes are merged LAST so they win via tailwind-merge.
	HeaderClass string
	// ContainerAware, when true, wraps the card in a @container div and swaps
	// sm: breakpoint classes for @sm: so padding adapts to container width,
	// not the viewport. Default false (viewport breakpoints). The @container
	// wrapper applies container-type: inline-size containment, which
	// suppresses the card's intrinsic width: inside shrink-to-fit parents
	// (flex rows, inline-block, auto-sized grid columns) a container-aware
	// card collapses to zero width unless the parent provides a definite
	// width. That is why Card is opt-in. See ADR-0018.
	ContainerAware bool
}

// DefaultCardProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultCardProps() CardProps {
	return CardProps{
		Padding: CardPaddingMD,
	}
}

// cardHeaderPaddingClass returns the responsive padding for the card header.
// Container-aware variant swaps sm: for @sm: (complete Tailwind literals).
func cardHeaderPaddingClass(containerAware bool) string {
	if containerAware {
		return "px-4 py-4 @sm:px-6"
	}
	return "px-4 py-4 sm:px-6"
}

// cardFooterPaddingClass returns the responsive padding for the card footer.
func cardFooterPaddingClass(containerAware bool) string {
	if containerAware {
		return "px-4 py-3 @sm:px-6"
	}
	return "px-4 py-3 sm:px-6"
}

// Card renders a bordered card with optional header and footer
//
//	@display.Card(display.CardProps{Title: "Users", Subtitle: "Manage your users"}) {
//	   <p>Card content goes here</p>
//	 }
templ Card(props CardProps) {
	if props.ContainerAware {
		<div class="@container">
			@cardInner(props) {
				{ children... }
			}
		</div>
	} else {
		@cardInner(props) {
			{ children... }
		}
	}
}

templ cardInner(props CardProps) {
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class(cardShellClass+" overflow-hidden", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.Header != nil {
			<div class={ utils.Class("flex items-center justify-between "+cardHeaderPaddingClass(props.ContainerAware)+" border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700", props.HeaderClass) }>
				@props.Header
			</div>
		} else if props.Title != "" || props.HeaderAction != nil {
			<div class={ utils.Class("flex items-center justify-between "+cardHeaderPaddingClass(props.ContainerAware)+" border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700", props.HeaderClass) }>
				<div>
					if props.Title != "" {
						@headingTag(props.TitleTag, utils.Class("text-base font-semibold leading-6 text-gray-900 dark:text-white break-after-avoid", props.TitleClass), props.Title)
					}
					if props.Subtitle != "" {
						<p class={ utils.Class(mutedTextClass, "mt-1") }>{ props.Subtitle }</p>
					}
				</div>
				if props.HeaderAction != nil {
					<div class="flex-shrink-0">
						@props.HeaderAction
					</div>
				}
			</div>
		}
		if props.Padding == CardPaddingNone {
			if props.Body != nil {
				@props.Body
			} else {
				{ children... }
			}
		} else {
			<div class={ cardPaddingClass(props.Padding, props.ContainerAware) }>
				if props.Body != nil {
					@props.Body
				} else {
					{ children... }
				}
			</div>
		}
		if props.Footer != nil {
			<div class={ cardFooterPaddingClass(props.ContainerAware) + " bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900/50 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700" }>
				@props.Footer
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for card padding
var cardPaddingLookup = map[CardPadding]string{
	CardPaddingNone: "",
	CardPaddingSM:   "px-3 py-3",
	CardPaddingMD:   "px-4 py-5 sm:p-6",
	CardPaddingLG:   "px-6 py-6",
}

// cardPaddingLookupContainer mirrors cardPaddingLookup with @container-keyed
// breakpoints (@sm:) so container-aware cards adapt padding to their parent's
// width instead of the viewport.
var cardPaddingLookupContainer = map[CardPadding]string{
	CardPaddingNone: "",
	CardPaddingSM:   "px-3 py-3",
	CardPaddingMD:   "px-4 py-5 @sm:p-6",
	CardPaddingLG:   "px-6 py-6",
}

func cardPaddingClass(p CardPadding, containerAware bool) string {
	if containerAware {
		return utils.Lookup(cardPaddingLookupContainer, p, cardPaddingLookupContainer[CardPaddingMD])
	}
	return utils.Lookup(cardPaddingLookup, p, cardPaddingLookup[CardPaddingMD])
}

// SimpleCardProps configures a simple card without header/footer
type SimpleCardProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Padding CardPadding
	// Body, when set, overrides children — same pattern as CardProps.Body.
	Body templ.Component
}

// DefaultSimpleCardProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultSimpleCardProps() SimpleCardProps {
	return SimpleCardProps{
		Padding: CardPaddingSM,
	}
}

// SimpleCard renders a card without header/footer for quick use.
// Internally composes through Card for consistent shell styling.
//
//	@display.SimpleCard(display.SimpleCardProps{}) {
//	   <p>Content</p>
//	 }
templ SimpleCard(props SimpleCardProps) {
	@Card(CardProps{
		BaseProps: props.BaseProps,
		Padding:   props.Padding,
		Body:      props.Body,
	}) {
		{ children... }
	}
}

// TrendDirection represents the direction of a stat change
type TrendDirection string

const (
	TrendUp   TrendDirection = "up"
	TrendDown TrendDirection = "down"
	TrendWarn TrendDirection = "warn"
	TrendNone TrendDirection = "none"
)

// StatTone selects the semantic color of the StatCard icon tile. The zero
// value is the neutral default (blue) so existing call sites are unaffected.
type StatTone string

// Stat tile tones. Match the palette of Badge/BadgeType: blue (default),
// green, yellow, red, purple.
const (
	StatToneBlue   StatTone = "blue"
	StatToneGreen  StatTone = "green"
	StatToneYellow StatTone = "yellow"
	StatToneRed    StatTone = "red"
	StatTonePurple StatTone = "purple"
)

// StatToneIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined StatTone constants.
// Map-driven off statTileLookup, so adding a tone constant keeps it in sync.
func StatToneIsValid(v StatTone) bool {
	_, ok := statTileLookup[v]

	return ok
}

// StatCardProps configures a dashboard stat card
type StatCardProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Value  string
	Label  string
	Change string
	Trend  TrendDirection
	// Tone selects the semantic color of the Icon tile. Empty/unknown
	// values fall back to the blue default.
	Tone StatTone
	// Icon optionally renders a leading icon tile (e.g. icons.Users).
	Icon icons.Name
	// Href, when non-empty, wraps the whole card in an <a> so the card acts
	// as a clickable navigation/filter link. Use this for dashboard stat cards
	// that drill down into a filtered view.
	Href string
	// HxGet, when set, adds hx-get to the card for HTMX-driven updates.
	// Mutually independent of Href — Href navigates, HxGet fetches partial HTML.
	// An HxGet card renders as an interactive control (role="button",
	// tabindex="0", focus ring) and Enter/Space activate it like a click, so
	// keyboard users are not locked out of the tile. The card ships the
	// activation script inline, so under a nonce-based CSP pass BaseProps.Nonce.
	HxGet string
	// HxTarget specifies the hx-target attribute (CSS selector for the swap target).
	HxTarget string
	// HxSwap specifies the hx-swap attribute (e.g. htmx.SwapInnerHTML, htmx.SwapOuterHTML).
	HxSwap htmx.SwapStyle
	// ValueID, when non-empty, sets the id attribute on the value <dd> node.
	// Use on live-updating dashboards whose scripts address the value
	// directly instead of querying the card's internal structure — so a
	// markup refactor inside the card cannot break the script's selector.
	ValueID string
}

// DefaultStatCardProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultStatCardProps() StatCardProps {
	return StatCardProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct // intentionally minimal defaults
		Trend: TrendNone,
	}
}

// validTrendDirections is the set of allowed TrendDirection values.
var validTrendDirections = map[TrendDirection]bool{
	TrendUp:   true,
	TrendDown: true,
	TrendWarn: true,
	TrendNone: true,
}

// normalizeTrend returns the trend if valid, or TrendNone for invalid values.
func normalizeTrend(t TrendDirection) TrendDirection {
	if validTrendDirections[t] {
		return t
	}
	return TrendNone
}

// statTileLookup maps each StatTone onto the icon tile background and icon
// color classes. Unknown/empty tones fall back to the blue default.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table, same pattern as button variants
var statTileLookup = map[StatTone]string{
	StatToneBlue:   "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30|h-6 w-6 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
	StatToneGreen:  "bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/30|h-6 w-6 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400",
	StatToneYellow: "bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/30|h-6 w-6 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400",
	StatToneRed:    "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30|h-6 w-6 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
	StatTonePurple: "bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/30|h-6 w-6 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400",
}

// statTileClasses returns the tile background class and icon class for the
// tone, falling back to blue for unknown values.
func statTileClasses(tone StatTone) (tile, icon string) {
	classes, ok := statTileLookup[tone]
	if !ok {
		classes = statTileLookup[StatToneBlue]
	}

	tile, icon, _ = strings.Cut(classes, "|")

	return tile, icon
}

// statCardInteractiveClass returns the affordance classes for an htmx-driven
// tile, which the div branch must carry itself: the linked variant gets them
// for free from being an <a>. Empty for a plain (non-interactive) card.
func statCardInteractiveClass(interactive bool) string {
	if !interactive {
		return ""
	}

	return "cursor-pointer transition-shadow motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent-500 dark:focus-visible:ring-accent-400 hover:shadow-md dark:hover:shadow-black/20"
}

// StatCard renders a dashboard stat card with value, label, optional change
// indicator, and an optional leading icon tile. When Href is set, the whole
// card is wrapped in an <a> so it acts as a clickable navigation link.
//
//	@display.StatCard(display.StatCardProps{Label: "Users", Value: "1,204", Icon: icons.Users})
//	@display.StatCard(display.StatCardProps{Label: "Active", Value: "42", Href: "/?activity=active"})
templ StatCard(props StatCardProps) {
	if props.Href != "" {
		<a
			href={ templ.SafeURL(props.Href) }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class(cardShellClass+" p-5 transition-shadow motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent-500 dark:focus-visible:ring-accent-400 hover:shadow-md dark:hover:shadow-black/20 cursor-pointer", props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			if props.HxGet != "" {
				hx-get={ props.HxGet }
			}
			if props.HxTarget != "" {
				hx-target={ props.HxTarget }
			}
			if props.HxSwap != "" {
				hx-swap={ props.HxSwap }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			@statCardInner(props)
		</a>
	} else {
		if props.HxGet != "" {
			@utils.ScriptComponent(props.Nonce, htmxTileActivateJS(), "htmx tile activation script")
		}
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class(cardShellClass+" p-5", statCardInteractiveClass(props.HxGet != ""), props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			if props.HxGet != "" {
				role="button"
				tabindex="0"
				data-tc-hx-activate
				hx-get={ props.HxGet }
			}
			if props.HxTarget != "" {
				hx-target={ props.HxTarget }
			}
			if props.HxSwap != "" {
				hx-swap={ props.HxSwap }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			@statCardInner(props)
		</div>
	}
}

// statCardInner renders the icon/value/label body shared by both the linked
// and unlinked StatCard layouts.
templ statCardInner(props StatCardProps) {
	if props.Icon != "" {
		<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
			@statTile(props.Tone, props.Icon)
			<dl class="min-w-0 flex-1">
				@statCardFigures(props)
			</dl>
		</div>
	} else {
		<dl>
			@statCardFigures(props)
		</dl>
	}
}

// statTile renders the colored icon tile; the tone picks the semantic color.
templ statTile(tone StatTone, icon icons.Name) {
	{{ tile, iconClass := statTileClasses(tone) }}
	<div class={ "flex h-12 w-12 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg", tile }>
		@icons.Icon(icon, iconClass)
	</div>
}

// statCardFigures renders the label, value, and optional change indicator shared
// by both the icon and no-icon StatCard layouts.
templ statCardFigures(props StatCardProps) {
	{{ trend := normalizeTrend(props.Trend) }}
	<div class="mt-1 flex flex-col">
		<dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 truncate">{ props.Label }</dt>
		<dd
			if props.ValueID != "" {
				id={ props.ValueID }
			}
			class={ "text-2xl font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white",
				templ.KV("flex flex-wrap items-baseline", props.Change != "") }
		>
			{ props.Value }
			if props.Change != "" {
				<span
					class={ "ms-2 flex items-baseline text-sm font-semibold",
				templ.KV("text-green-700 dark:text-green-400", trend == TrendUp),
				templ.KV("text-red-600 dark:text-red-400", trend == TrendDown),
				templ.KV("text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400", trend == TrendWarn) }
				>
					switch trend {
						case TrendUp:
							@svg.FillIcon("self-center flex-shrink-0 h-4 w-4 text-green-500 dark:text-green-400", svg.PathArrowUp, false)
						case TrendDown:
							@svg.FillIcon("self-center flex-shrink-0 h-4 w-4 text-red-500 dark:text-red-400", svg.PathArrowDown, false)
						case TrendWarn:
							@svg.FillIcon("self-center flex-shrink-0 h-4 w-4 text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400", svg.PathArrowRight, false)
					}
					<span class="sr-only">
						switch trend {
							case TrendUp:
								Increased by
							case TrendDown:
								Decreased by
							case TrendWarn:
								Holding at
						}
					</span>
					{ props.Change }
				</span>
			}
		</dd>
	</div>
}

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/svg"

// carouselDotActiveClass and carouselDotIdleClass paint the visual dot inside
// a 24×24 hit-box button (WCAG 2.2 target size, M21/F097): the dot stays 8px
// while the BUTTON carries the target. Mirrored verbatim in the carousel JS
// (activeDot/idleDot) — keep the three sites in sync.
const (
	carouselDotActiveClass = "h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent-600 dark:bg-accent-500"
	carouselDotIdleClass   = "h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-gray-400/60 dark:bg-gray-500/60"
)

// CarouselSlide represents a single slide in a carousel.
type CarouselSlide struct {
	Content templ.Component
}

// CarouselProps configures a content carousel with prev/next navigation.
// Uses CSS scroll-snap for native touch/drag support and smooth scrolling.
type CarouselProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Slides         []CarouselSlide
	ShowIndicators bool
	ShowArrows     bool
}

// DefaultCarouselProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultCarouselProps() CarouselProps {
	return CarouselProps{
		ShowArrows: true,
	}
}

// Carousel renders a slide carousel with native CSS scroll-snap for
// touch-friendly swiping, momentum scrolling, and smooth programmatic
// navigation. Prev/next buttons use scrollBy; dots sync via scrollend.
//
//	@display.Carousel(display.CarouselProps{
//	   Slides: []display.CararouselSlide{
//	     {Content: templ.Raw("<div>Slide 1</div>")},
//	     {Content: templ.Raw("<div>Slide 2</div>")},
//	   },
//	   ShowIndicators: true,
//	})
templ Carousel(props CarouselProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("carousel", props.ID) }}
	<div
		id={ id }
		class={ utils.Class("relative rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent-500 dark:focus-visible:ring-accent-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-white dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-gray-900", props.Class) }
		data-tc-carousel={ id }
		role="region"
		aria-roledescription="carousel"
		aria-label={ utils.Coalesce(props.AriaLabel, "Carousel") }
		tabindex="0"
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div
			class="flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-smooth scrollbar-none"
			data-tc-carousel-track
			role="group"
			tabindex="0"
			aria-label="Slides"
		>
			for i, slide := range props.Slides {
				<div
					class="w-full flex-shrink-0 snap-center"
					role="group"
					aria-roledescription="slide"
					aria-label={ fmt.Sprintf("Slide %d of %d", i+1, len(props.Slides)) }
				>
					if slide.Content != nil {
						@slide.Content
					}
				</div>
			}
		</div>
		if props.ShowArrows && len(props.Slides) > 1 {
			<button
				type="button"
				class="absolute inset-s-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-2 rounded-full bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-800/80 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-gray-800 shadow-sm"
				data-tc-carousel-prev
				aria-label="Previous slide"
			>
				<svg class="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
					<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d={ svg.PathArrowLeft }></path>
				</svg>
			</button>
			<button
				type="button"
				class="absolute inset-e-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-2 rounded-full bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-800/80 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-gray-800 shadow-sm"
				data-tc-carousel-next
				aria-label="Next slide"
			>
				<svg class="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
					<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d={ svg.PathArrowRight }></path>
				</svg>
			</button>
		}
		if props.ShowIndicators && len(props.Slides) > 1 {
			<div class="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex gap-1.5">
				for i := range props.Slides {
					<button
						type="button"
						class="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none"
						data-tc-carousel-dot={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", i) }
						aria-label={ fmt.Sprintf("Go to slide %d", i+1) }
					>
						<span class={ utils.Ternary(i == 0, carouselDotActiveClass, carouselDotIdleClass) }></span>
					</button>
				}
			</div>
		}
		if props.Nonce != "" {
		@utils.ScriptComponent(props.Nonce, carouselJS, "carousel script")
		}
	</div>
}

import (

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// chartAxes renders the Y-axis ticks, optional gridlines, axis lines, and
// X-axis labels. Shared between LineChart and AreaChart.
//
// ComputeNiceTicks covers the data domain (first tick <= min, last tick >=
// max — pinned by the geometry property test), so its outermost ticks can
// fall OUTSIDE the data range. chartAxes projects ticks with the DATA range,
// so out-of-domain ticks would land outside the plot area: below the x-axis
// (colliding with the x labels) or above the plot top. They are skipped.
templ chartAxes(d ChartRenderData) {
	for _, tick := range d.Ticks {
		if tick >= d.MinVal-tickDomainEpsilon && tick <= d.MaxVal+tickDomainEpsilon {
			{{ y := float64(d.Padding.Top) + float64(d.PlotH) - ((tick-d.MinVal)/d.RangeVal)*float64(d.PlotH) }}
			if d.ShowGrid {
				<line
					x1={ d.Padding.Left }
					y1={ y }
					x2={ d.Width - d.Padding.Right }
					y2={ y }
					class="stroke-gray-200 dark:stroke-gray-700"
					stroke-width="1"
					stroke-dasharray="4 4"
				></line>
			}
			<text
				x={ d.Padding.Left - lineChartTickLen }
				y={ y + lineChartLabelYOffset }
				text-anchor="end"
				class="fill-gray-500 dark:fill-gray-400"
				font-size={ lineChartFontSize }
			>{ lineChartTickFormat(d.ValueFormat, tick) }</text>
		}
	}
	<line
		x1={ d.Padding.Left }
		y1={ d.Padding.Top }
		x2={ d.Padding.Left }
		y2={ d.Padding.Top + d.PlotH }
		class="stroke-gray-300 dark:stroke-gray-600"
		stroke-width="1"
	></line>
	<line
		x1={ d.Padding.Left }
		y1={ d.Padding.Top + d.PlotH }
		x2={ d.Width - d.Padding.Right }
		y2={ d.Padding.Top + d.PlotH }
		class="stroke-gray-300 dark:stroke-gray-600"
		stroke-width="1"
	></line>
	if d.LabelCount > 0 {
		for i := range d.LabelCount {
			if i < len(d.XAxisLabels) {
				{{
					// Boundary labels anchor inward so they never cross the
					// axis lines: a middle-anchored first label collides with
					// the y-axis tick text, a middle-anchored last label
					// overflows the right edge.
					anchor := "middle"
					x := d.Padding.Left + int(lineChartTickLabelX(d.PlotW, d.LabelCount, i))
					switch i {
					case 0:
						anchor = "start"
						x = d.Padding.Left
					case d.LabelCount - 1:
						anchor = "end"
						x = d.Padding.Left + d.PlotW
					}
				}}
				<text
					x={ x }
					y={ d.Padding.Top + d.PlotH + lineChartXLabelOffset }
					text-anchor={ anchor }
					class="fill-gray-500 dark:fill-gray-400"
					font-size={ lineChartFontSize }
				>{ d.XAxisLabels[i] }</text>
			}
		}
	}
}

// chartLegend renders the color-swatch legend above the chart. Shared between
// LineChart and AreaChart.
templ chartLegend(d ChartRenderData) {
	if len(d.LegendItems) > 0 {
		for _, li := range d.LegendItems {
			<g transform={ fmt.Sprintf("translate(%d,%d)", li.X, lineChartLegendY) }>
				<rect
					width="14"
					height="3"
					y="-2"
					rx="1"
					class={ li.Color }
					fill="currentColor"
				></rect>
				<text
					x="18"
					y="2"
					class="fill-gray-600 dark:fill-gray-300"
					font-size={ lineChartFontSize }
				>{ li.Name }</text>
			</g>
		}
	}
}

// chartEmptyStateMsg renders the "No data" message centered in the SVG canvas.
// Shared between LineChart and AreaChart.
templ chartEmptyStateMsg(d ChartRenderData) {
	<text
		x={ d.Width / 2 }
		y={ d.Height / 2 }
		text-anchor="middle"
		dominant-baseline="middle"
		class="fill-gray-400 dark:fill-gray-500"
		font-size={ lineChartEmptyFontSize }
	>{ d.EmptyMsg }</text>
}

// chartSeriesRenderOpts carries the per-chart series rendering switches.
type chartSeriesRenderOpts struct {
	// filled renders the semi-transparent area fill under the line (AreaChart).
	filled bool
	// fillOpacity is the area fill opacity string; only used when filled.
	fillOpacity string
	// showDots renders a circle at every projected point.
	showDots bool
}

// chartSeriesGroup renders one series as an SVG group: optional area fill,
// the stroked line (smooth or linear), and optional dots. Shared by LineChart
// and AreaChart so stroke, dash, and dot rendering stay in lockstep.
templ chartSeriesGroup(d ChartRenderData, series LineChartSeries, i int, style LineChartStyle, opts chartSeriesRenderOpts) {
	{{
		color := lineChartColor(i, series.Color)
		strokeW := lineChartStrokeWidth(series.StrokeWidth)
		pts := ScalePoints(series.Values, d.PlotW, d.PlotH, d.MinVal, d.MaxVal)

		var linePath string
		if style == LineChartStyleSmooth {
			linePath = BuildSmoothPath(pts)
		} else {
			linePath = BuildPolylinePath(pts)
		}

		// The fill edge must follow the same curve as the stroked line:
		// a straight area under a smooth line visibly detached from it.
		var areaPath string
		if style == LineChartStyleSmooth {
			areaPath = BuildSmoothAreaPath(pts, d.PlotH)
		} else {
			areaPath = BuildAreaPath(pts, d.PlotH)
		}
	}}
	<g
		class={ color }
		transform={ fmt.Sprintf("translate(%d,%d)", d.Padding.Left, d.Padding.Top) }
	>
		if opts.filled {
			<path
				d={ areaPath }
				fill="currentColor"
				fill-opacity={ opts.fillOpacity }
				stroke="none"
			></path>
		}
		<path
			d={ linePath }
			fill="none"
			stroke="currentColor"
			stroke-width={ fmt.Sprintf("%g", strokeW) }
			stroke-linecap="round"
			stroke-linejoin="round"
			if series.Dashed {
				stroke-dasharray="5 5"
			}
		></path>
		if opts.showDots {
			for _, p := range pts {
				<circle cx={ p.X } cy={ p.Y } r={ lineChartDotRadius } fill="currentColor"></circle>
			}
		}
	</g>
}

// lineAreaChartSVG renders the shared SVG shell for LineChart and AreaChart:
// viewBox, a11y attributes, axes, the per-series groups, legend, and the
// empty-state message. The caller supplies the series render options (filled
// vs stroked-only) so both chart types keep identical chrome.
templ lineAreaChartSVG(d ChartRenderData, series []LineChartSeries, style LineChartStyle, opts chartSeriesRenderOpts) {
	<svg
		viewBox={ fmt.Sprintf("0 0 %d %d", d.Width, d.Height) }
		class={ utils.Class("w-full h-auto", d.Class) }
		role="img"
		if d.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ d.AriaLabel }
		} else {
			aria-hidden="true"
		}
		if d.ID != "" {
			id={ d.ID }
		}
		{ d.Attrs... }
	>
		if d.HasData {
			@chartAxes(d)
			for i, s := range series {
				if len(s.Values) >= 2 {
					@chartSeriesGroup(d, s, i, style, opts)
				}
			}
			@chartLegend(d)
		} else {
			@chartEmptyStateMsg(d)
		}
	</svg>
}
// CodeBlock component: a styled code display with an integrated copy
// button — the shared shape behind "copyable command" rows (mr-sync's
// commandLine) and detail-page ID rows (DiscordSync's copyIDRow), extracted
// per the 2026-10-10 four-project analysis (TODO_LIST #389).
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// CodeBlockVariant selects the rendering shape. Structural variants use an
// if-branch in the template (map lookups are for class data, not DOM shape).
type CodeBlockVariant string

// Code block variant constants.
const (
	// CodeBlockBlock renders a figure with an optional header (language or
	// label) and a scrollable pre/code body. The zero value.
	CodeBlockBlock CodeBlockVariant = "block"
	// CodeBlockCompactID renders an inline monospace row with a copy button —
	// the detail-page "copy this ID" pattern.
	CodeBlockCompactID CodeBlockVariant = "compact-id"
)

// CodeBlockVariantIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined variants.
// Unknown values render the block variant (graceful fallback, never a panic).
func CodeBlockVariantIsValid(v CodeBlockVariant) bool {
	return v == CodeBlockBlock || v == CodeBlockCompactID
}

// CodeBlockProps configures a code block.
type CodeBlockProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Code is the text to display and copy. Rendered HTML-escaped by templ.
	Code string
	// Language optionally labels the block's language in the header
	// ("bash", "go"). It is a label only — CodeBlock does not syntax-highlight.
	Language string
	// Label optionally overrides the header label. Defaults to Language
	// when Language is set and Label is empty; both empty renders no header
	// label (a copy-only header when copying is enabled).
	Label string
	// NoCopy hides the copy button. The zero value shows it — both extraction
	// demand shapes (copyable command rows, ID rows) always carry copy.
	NoCopy bool
	// Variant selects block (zero value) or compact-id rendering.
	Variant CodeBlockVariant
}

// DefaultCodeBlockProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultCodeBlockProps() CodeBlockProps {
	return CodeBlockProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // intentionally minimal defaults
		Language: "bash",
	}
}

// codeBlockLabel resolves the header label: explicit Label wins, then
// Language, then none.
func codeBlockLabel(props CodeBlockProps) string {
	if props.Label != "" {
		return props.Label
	}

	return props.Language
}
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// codeBlockCopy renders the integrated copy button with the component's
// nonce threaded through (CSP-safe singleton script; see CopyButton).
templ codeBlockCopy(code, nonce string) {
	@CopyButton(CopyButtonProps{
		BaseProps: utils.BaseProps{Nonce: nonce},
		Text:      code,
		Icon:      true,
	})
}

// CodeBlock renders a code display with an integrated copy button.
//
//	@display.CodeBlock(display.CodeBlockProps{Code: "go install ./...", Language: "bash"})
//
// Variant display.CodeBlockCompactID renders the inline "copy this ID" row
// used on detail pages.
templ CodeBlock(props CodeBlockProps) {
	if props.Variant == CodeBlockCompactID {
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400", props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			<span class="font-mono truncate" title={ props.Code }>{ props.Code }</span>
			if !props.NoCopy {
				@codeBlockCopy(props.Code, props.Nonce)
			}
		</div>
	} else {
		<figure
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-md", props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			{{ label := codeBlockLabel(props) }}
			if label != "" || !props.NoCopy {
				<figcaption class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 ps-3 pe-2 py-1.5">
					if label != "" {
						<span class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ label }</span>
					}
					if !props.NoCopy {
						@codeBlockCopy(props.Code, props.Nonce)
					}
				</figcaption>
			}
			<pre class="overflow-x-auto p-4"><code class="block font-mono text-[0.8125rem] leading-relaxed text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200">{ props.Code }</code></pre>
		</figure>
	}
}

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// CollapsibleSection wraps content in a native <details>/<summary> pair so
// users can collapse detail-heavy regions. The section renders open by
// default. When StorageKey is set, the open/closed state can be persisted
// to localStorage: either by a consumer-side script reading the
// data-collapsible attribute, or — with PersistState and Nonce set — by
// the built-in nonce'd persistence script this component ships.
//
//	@display.CollapsibleSection(display.CollapsibleSectionProps{
//	   Title: "Advanced Filters",
//	   StorageKey: "advanced-filters",
//	   PersistState: true,
//	   Nonce: nonce,
//	}) {
//	   <p>Collapsible content here.</p>
//	}
templ CollapsibleSection(props CollapsibleSectionProps) {
	{{ p := resolveCollapsibleDefaults(props) }}
	<details
		class={ utils.Class("group rounded-lg", p.Class) }
		if p.StorageKey != "" {
			data-collapsible={ p.StorageKey }
		}
		if p.ID != "" {
			id={ p.ID }
		}
		if !p.Collapsed {
			open
		}
		{ p.Attrs... }
	>
		<summary class="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-1 py-1 text-gray-900 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--ds-brand)] hover:bg-gray-50 dark:text-white dark:hover:bg-gray-800 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
			@headingTag(p.TitleTag, "text-lg font-semibold", p.Title)
			@icons.Icon(p.Icon, "h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 transition-transform duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-200 group-open:rotate-180")
		</summary>
		<div class="mt-4">
			{ children... }
		</div>
	</details>
	if p.PersistState && p.StorageKey != "" && p.Nonce != "" {
		@collapsiblePersistScript(p.Nonce)
	}
}

// collapsiblePersistScript is the built-in persistence singleton (ADR-0005):
// first run restores every details[data-collapsible] from localStorage and
// attaches one capture-phase toggle listener (toggle does not bubble);
// re-runs after HTMX swaps only re-apply saved state to (re)rendered
// elements — the listener is never double-bound. localStorage is wrapped
// in try/catch for Safari private mode.
templ collapsiblePersistScript(nonce string) {
	<script nonce={ nonce }>
		(function () {
			"use strict";
			function applyAll() {
				document.querySelectorAll("details[data-collapsible]").forEach(function (el) {
					try {
						var saved = localStorage.getItem(el.getAttribute("data-collapsible"));
						if (saved === "open") el.open = true;
						else if (saved === "closed") el.open = false;
					} catch (err) { /* private mode */ }
				});
			}
			applyAll();
			if (window.tcCollapsiblePersistAttached) return;
			window.tcCollapsiblePersistAttached = true;
			document.addEventListener("toggle", function (e) {
				var el = e.target;
				if (!el.matches || !el.matches("details[data-collapsible]")) return;
				try {
					localStorage.setItem(el.getAttribute("data-collapsible"), el.open ? "open" : "closed");
				} catch (err) { /* private mode */ }
			}, true);
		})();
	</script>
}

// CommandPalette renders a CSP-safe command palette: a <dialog> with a search
// input filtering server-rendered groups client-side. Items select via links
// (Href) or wire actions (Wire — htmx or Datastar through one spec). Open it
// with the built-in trigger button (TriggerLabel), the Cmd/Ctrl+K hotkey
// (Hotkey), or your own element carrying data-tc-palette-open.
//
//	@display.CommandPalette(display.CommandPaletteProps{
//	   TriggerLabel: "Commands", Hotkey: true,
//	   Groups: []display.CommandGroup{
//	     {Label: "Pages", Items: []display.CommandItem{{Label: "Dashboard", Href: "/dashboard"}}},
//	   },
//	})
//
// The native <dialog> provides focus trapping, Escape-to-close, top-layer
// rendering, and ::backdrop; the tc-overlay/tc-modal classes select the
// shared animation profile in app.css.
templ CommandPalette(props CommandPaletteProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("palette", props.ID) }}
	{{ emptyMessage := utils.Coalesce(props.EmptyMessage, "No results found.") }}
	{{ inputPlaceholder := utils.Coalesce(props.Placeholder, "Type a command or search…") }}
	{{ listLabel := utils.Coalesce(props.AriaLabel, "Commands") }}
	<div class="inline-flex">
		if props.TriggerLabel != "" {
			<button
				type="button"
				class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
				data-tc-palette-open
				aria-haspopup="dialog"
			>
				{ props.TriggerLabel }
				if props.Hotkey {
					<kbd class="rounded border border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 px-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-gray-500 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-gray-400">⌘K</kbd>
				}
			</button>
		}
	</div>
	<dialog
		id={ id }
		class={ utils.Class("tc-overlay tc-modal mt-[12vh] mb-auto h-fit w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-xl bg-white p-0 shadow-xl print:hidden dark:bg-gray-900", commandPaletteSizeClass(props.Size), props.Class) }
		data-tc-palette={ id }
		closedby="any"
		if props.Hotkey {
			data-tc-hotkey="true"
		}
		aria-label={ utils.Coalesce(props.AriaLabel, "Command palette") }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div class="border-gray-200 border-b dark:border-gray-700">
			<input
				type="text"
				id={ id + "-input" }
				class="w-full bg-transparent px-4 py-3.5 text-sm text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-hidden dark:text-white dark:placeholder:text-gray-500"
				role="combobox"
				aria-expanded="true"
				aria-controls={ id + "-list" }
				aria-autocomplete="list"
				aria-label={ inputPlaceholder }
				autocomplete="off"
				placeholder={ inputPlaceholder }
				data-tc-palette-input
			/>
		</div>
		<div
			role="listbox"
			aria-label={ listLabel }
			class="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-2"
			data-tc-palette-list
		>
			{{ itemOffset := 0 }}
			for _, group := range props.Groups {
				if len(group.Items) > 0 {
					<div
						class="py-1"
						role="group"
						aria-label={ group.Label }
						data-tc-palette-group
						data-tc-palette-hidden="false"
					>
						if group.Label != "" {
							<div class="px-2 pb-1 pt-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">
								{ group.Label }
							</div>
						}
						for itemIndex, item := range group.Items {
							{{ itemID := commandPaletteItemID(id, itemOffset+itemIndex) }}
							if commandPaletteItemIsLink(item) {
								<a
									id={ itemID }
									href={ templ.SafeURL(item.Href) }
									role="option"
									aria-selected="false"
									tabindex="-1"
									class="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 data-[tc-palette-active=true]:bg-accent-50 data-[tc-palette-hidden=true]:hidden dark:text-gray-200 dark:data-[tc-palette-active=true]:bg-gray-800"
									data-tc-palette-item
									data-tc-palette-hidden="false"
								>
									<span class="truncate">{ item.Label }</span>
									if item.Hint != "" {
										<span class="shrink-0 text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">{ item.Hint }</span>
									}
								</a>
							} else if item.Wire != nil {
								<button
									id={ itemID }
									type="button"
									role="option"
									aria-selected="false"
									tabindex="-1"
									class="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-start text-sm text-gray-700 data-[tc-palette-active=true]:bg-accent-50 data-[tc-palette-hidden=true]:hidden dark:text-gray-200 dark:data-[tc-palette-active=true]:bg-gray-800"
									data-tc-palette-item
									data-tc-palette-hidden="false"
									{ item.Wire.Attributes()... }
								>
									<span class="truncate">{ item.Label }</span>
									if item.Hint != "" {
										<span class="shrink-0 text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">{ item.Hint }</span>
									}
								</button>
							} else {
								<div
									id={ itemID }
									role="option"
									aria-selected="false"
									tabindex="-1"
									class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 data-[tc-palette-active=true]:bg-accent-50 data-[tc-palette-hidden=true]:hidden dark:text-gray-400"
									data-tc-palette-item
									data-tc-palette-hidden="false"
								>
									<span class="truncate">{ item.Label }</span>
									if item.Hint != "" {
										<span class="shrink-0 text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">{ item.Hint }</span>
									}
								</div>
							}
						}
					</div>
				}
				{{ itemOffset += len(group.Items) }}
			}
			<div class="px-3 py-8 text-center text-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500" data-tc-palette-empty data-tc-palette-hidden="true">
				{ emptyMessage }
			</div>
		</div>
	</dialog>
	@utils.ScriptComponent(props.Nonce, commandPaletteJS(id), "command palette script")
}
