import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// HeadingLevel defines the HTML heading element used by SectionHeading.
type HeadingLevel string

const (
	HeadingLevelH1 HeadingLevel = "h1"
	HeadingLevelH2 HeadingLevel = "h2"
	HeadingLevelH3 HeadingLevel = "h3"
	HeadingLevelH4 HeadingLevel = "h4"
	HeadingLevelH5 HeadingLevel = "h5"
	HeadingLevelH6 HeadingLevel = "h6"
)

// headingLevelClass returns the Tailwind text size class for a heading level.
func headingLevelClass(level HeadingLevel) string {
	switch level {
	case HeadingLevelH1:
		return "text-3xl font-bold"
	case HeadingLevelH2:
		return "text-2xl font-bold"
	case HeadingLevelH3:
		return "text-xl font-semibold"
	case HeadingLevelH4:
		return "text-lg font-semibold"
	case HeadingLevelH5:
		return "text-base font-semibold"
	case HeadingLevelH6:
		return "text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide"
	default:
		return "text-2xl font-bold"
	}
}

// TextAlign defines the horizontal alignment of a SectionHeading.
type TextAlign string

const (
	TextAlignLeft   TextAlign = "left"
	TextAlignCenter TextAlign = "center"
	TextAlignRight  TextAlign = "right"
)

// textAlignClass returns the Tailwind text alignment class.
func textAlignClass(align TextAlign) string {
	switch align {
	case TextAlignCenter:
		return "text-center"
	case TextAlignRight:
		return "text-end"
	default:
		return "text-start"
	}
}

// sectionHeadingTitleClass combines the heading level, base title classes,
// and optional override into a single class string.
func sectionHeadingTitleClass(level HeadingLevel, override string) string {
	return utils.Class(headingLevelClass(level), "text-gray-900 dark:text-white break-after-avoid", override)
}

// SectionHeadingProps configures a section-level heading with typed
// heading level and alignment.
type SectionHeadingProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Title    string
	Level    HeadingLevel
	Align    TextAlign
	SubTitle string
}

// SectionHeading renders a section-level heading with configurable heading
// element (h1-h6), alignment, and optional subtitle. Headings include
// break-after-avoid for print pagination. Use this for section titles within
// page content (not the page title itself — use PageHeader for that).
//
//	@display.SectionHeading(display.SectionHeadingProps{
//	   Title: "Experience",
//	   Level: display.HeadingLevelH2,
//	   Align: display.TextAlignCenter,
//	})
templ SectionHeading(props SectionHeadingProps) {
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class(textAlignClass(props.Align), props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		switch props.Level {
			case HeadingLevelH1:
				<h1 class={ sectionHeadingTitleClass(props.Level, "") }>{ props.Title }</h1>
			case HeadingLevelH3:
				<h3 class={ sectionHeadingTitleClass(props.Level, "") }>{ props.Title }</h3>
			case HeadingLevelH4:
				<h4 class={ sectionHeadingTitleClass(props.Level, "") }>{ props.Title }</h4>
			case HeadingLevelH5:
				<h5 class={ sectionHeadingTitleClass(props.Level, "") }>{ props.Title }</h5>
			case HeadingLevelH6:
				<h6 class={ sectionHeadingTitleClass(props.Level, "") }>{ props.Title }</h6>
			default:
				<h2 class={ sectionHeadingTitleClass(props.Level, "") }>{ props.Title }</h2>
		}
		if props.SubTitle != "" {
			<p class={ utils.Class(mutedTextClass, "mt-1") }>{ props.SubTitle }</p>
		}
	</div>
}
// SegmentBar component: a stacked proportion bar with a legend — language
// shares, evidence breakdowns, storage composition. Extracted from
// mr-sync's language bars and nsfw-classifier's evidence proportions
// (2026-10-10 analysis, TODO_LIST #395).
package display

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/tone"
)

// SegmentBarSegment is one proportion of the bar.
type SegmentBarSegment struct {
	// Label names the segment in the legend and the accessible summary.
	Label string
	// Value is the segment's magnitude (relative to the sum of all values).
	// Negative values clamp to zero.
	Value float64
	// Color optionally overrides the deterministic palette — a complete
	// light+dark literal pair such as "bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400".
	Color tone.ColorClass
}

// SegmentBarProps configures a stacked proportion bar.
type SegmentBarProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Segments stack in the given order. A bar with no positive-value
	// segments renders nothing (an empty proportion bar is no bar).
	Segments []SegmentBarSegment
	// NoLegend hides the dot+label+percent legend. The zero value shows it.
	NoLegend bool
}

// DefaultSegmentBarProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultSegmentBarProps() SegmentBarProps {
	return SegmentBarProps{} //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // no non-zero defaults
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table: the shared chart palette as background class pairs
var segmentBarPalette = []tone.ColorClass{
	"bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400",
	"bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400",
	"bg-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-400",
	"bg-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-400",
	"bg-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-400",
	"bg-cyan-600 dark:bg-cyan-400",
	"bg-orange-600 dark:bg-orange-400",
	"bg-pink-600 dark:bg-pink-400",
}

// segmentBarColor resolves a segment's background class: explicit override
// first, then the deterministic palette keyed by label (stable across
// renders and filter orders — the same label always gets the same color).
func segmentBarColor(seg SegmentBarSegment) string {
	if seg.Color != "" {
		return string(seg.Color)
	}

	hash := 0

	for _, r := range seg.Label {
		hash = (hash*31 + int(r)) % len(segmentBarPalette)
	}

	return string(segmentBarPalette[hash])
}

// segmentBarTotal sums the clamped segment values.
func segmentBarTotal(segments []SegmentBarSegment) float64 {
	total := 0.0

	for _, seg := range segments {
		if seg.Value > 0 {
			total += seg.Value
		}
	}

	return total
}

// segmentBarPercent formats one segment's share of total with one decimal.
func segmentBarPercent(value, total float64) string {
	if total <= 0 {
		return "0.0%"
	}

	return strconv.FormatFloat(max(value, 0)/total*100, 'f', 1, 64) + "%"
}

// segmentBarAriaLabel composes the accessible summary ("Go 62.3%, TS 37.7%").
func segmentBarAriaLabel(segments []SegmentBarSegment, total float64) string {
	var parts []string

	for _, seg := range segments {
		if seg.Value > 0 && seg.Label != "" {
			parts = append(parts, seg.Label+" "+segmentBarPercent(seg.Value, total))
		}
	}

	return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
}
package display

import (
	"strconv"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// SegmentBar renders a stacked proportion bar with an optional legend.
//
//	@display.SegmentBar(display.SegmentBarProps{
//		Segments: []display.SegmentBarSegment{
//			{Label: "Go", Value: 62.3},
//			{Label: "TypeScript", Value: 37.7},
//		},
//	})
//
// Proportions use flex-grow (not percentage widths), so rounding never opens
// gaps between segments. The runtime flex-grow values are the component's
// documented inline-style exemption (same class as BarChart's bar widths —
// see utils.TestInlineStyleCompliance).
//
// The role="img" wraps ONLY the bar graphic (img is a leaf role — visible
// descendants under it are invalid ARIA, achecker aria_descendant_valid);
// the legend renders as a real list sibling, readable as ordinary content.
templ SegmentBar(props SegmentBarProps) {
	{{ total := segmentBarTotal(props.Segments) }}
	if total > 0 {
		{{
			label := props.AriaLabel
			if label == "" {
				label = segmentBarAriaLabel(props.Segments, total)
			}
		}}
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("flex flex-col gap-2", props.Class) }
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			<div class="flex h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full" role="img" aria-label={ label }>
				for _, seg := range props.Segments {
					if seg.Value > 0 {
						<div
							class={ segmentBarColor(seg) }
							style={ "flex-grow:" + strconv.FormatFloat(seg.Value, 'f', -1, 64) }
						></div>
					}
				}
			</div>
			if !props.NoLegend {
				<ul class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
					for _, seg := range props.Segments {
						if seg.Value > 0 {
							<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
								<span class={ "h-2 w-2 rounded-full " + segmentBarColor(seg) } aria-hidden="true"></span>
								{ seg.Label }
								<span class="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ segmentBarPercent(seg.Value, total) }</span>
							</li>
						}
					}
				</ul>
			}
		</div>
	}
}
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// overlayShell renders a native <dialog>-based overlay shell shared by Modal
// and Drawer. The <dialog> element provides top-layer rendering, focus trapping,
// Escape-to-close, focus restore, and ::backdrop — all native, no JS needed
// for those behaviors. CSS animations handle open/close via @starting-style
// and allow-discrete display transitions (defined in app.css).
//
// The dialog element IS the visual panel: dialogClass carries the Tailwind
// classes for background, border-radius, shadow, and sizing. A dialogClass
// prefix (tc-modal / tc-drawer) selects the animation profile in app.css.
templ overlayShell(p overlayShellProps) {
	{{ labelledBy := "" }}
	{{
		if p.title != "" {
			labelledBy = p.id + "-title"
		}
	}}
	<dialog
		id={ p.id }
		class={ utils.Class("tc-overlay", p.dialogClass) }
		if labelledBy != "" {
			aria-labelledby={ labelledBy }
		}
		if p.ariaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ p.ariaLabel }
		}
		if p.open {
			data-tc-open="true"
		}
		if p.kind == OverlayDrawer && p.side != "" {
			data-side={ string(p.side) }
		}
		closedby="any"
		{ p.attrs... }
	>
		@dialogHeader(p.title, p.id+"-title", p.kind)
		<div class="px-4 py-4 sm:px-6">
			{ children... }
		</div>
	</dialog>
	@overlayScriptComponent(p.nonce, p.id, p.kind.componentName())
}

templ dialogHeader(title, titleID string, kind OverlayKind) {
	if title != "" {
		<div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 sm:px-6 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
			<h2 id={ titleID } class="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ title }</h2>
			<button
				type="button"
				class="rounded-md text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-500 dark:hover:text-gray-300 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 dark:focus:ring-accent-400"
				data-tc-close={ string(kind) }
				aria-label="Close"
			>
				@icons.Icon(icons.X, "h-5 w-5")
			</button>
		</div>
	}
}

// headingTag renders a title as the requested heading element (h1-h6,
// defaulting to h3). Templ has no dynamic element names, so this switch is
// the single home for heading-level selection — shared by Card, EmptyState,
// and CollapsibleSection. Unknown or empty tags fall through to the default.
templ headingTag(tag HeadingTagType, class string, text string) {
	switch tag {
		case HeadingTagH1:
			<h1 class={ class }>{ text }</h1>
		case HeadingTagH2:
			<h2 class={ class }>{ text }</h2>
		case HeadingTagH4:
			<h4 class={ class }>{ text }</h4>
		case HeadingTagH5:
			<h5 class={ class }>{ text }</h5>
		case HeadingTagH6:
			<h6 class={ class }>{ text }</h6>
		default:
			<h3 class={ class }>{ text }</h3>
	}
}
package display

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// Sparkline renders a tiny inline SVG line chart showing a data trend.
// Pure SVG — no JavaScript. Uses currentColor for stroke so consumers control
// color via a Tailwind text color class on the parent or the Class prop.
//
//	@display.Sparkline(display.SparklineProps{Values: []float64{1, 3, 2, 5, 4, 6, 3}})
//	@display.Sparkline(display.SparklineProps{Values: rates, Filled: true, Class: "text-green-500 dark:text-green-400"})
//	@display.Sparkline(display.SparklineProps{Values: balance, Responsive: true})
//	@display.Sparkline(display.SparklineProps{Values: balance, Responsive: true, ShowZeroLine: true})
templ Sparkline(props SparklineProps) {
	{{
		width := props.Width
		if width == 0 {
			width = sparklineDefaultWidth
		}
		height := props.Height
		if height == 0 {
			height = sparklineDefaultHeight
		}
		strokeW := props.StrokeWidth
		if strokeW == 0 {
			strokeW = sparklineDefaultStroke
		}
		min, max := sparklineBounds(props)
		points := sparklinePoints(props.Values, width, height, min, max)
		zeroY := sparklineZeroY(min, max, height)
		viewBox := fmt.Sprintf("0 0 %d %d", width, height)
		svgClass := "overflow-visible"
		if props.Responsive {
			svgClass = "overflow-visible w-full h-auto"
		}
	}}
	if len(props.Values) >= 2 {
		<svg
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			if props.Responsive {
				viewBox={ viewBox }
				preserveAspectRatio="none"
			} else {
				width={ width }
				height={ height }
			}
			class={ utils.Class(svgClass, props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			} else {
				aria-hidden="true"
			}
		>
			if props.ShowZeroLine {
				<line x1="0" x2={ width } y1={ zeroY } y2={ zeroY } stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity="0.25"></line>
			}
			if props.Filled {
				<path
					d={ sparklineAreaPath(props.Values, width, height, min, max) }
					fill="currentColor"
					fill-opacity="0.15"
					class="opacity-50"
				></path>
			}
			<polyline
				points={ points }
				fill="none"
				stroke="currentColor"
				stroke-width={ strokeW }
				stroke-linecap="round"
				stroke-linejoin="round"
				if props.Responsive {
					vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
				}
			></polyline>
		</svg>
	}
}
// StatusDot and LivePill components: the colored status indicator family —
// a dot (optionally pulsing) and a dot+text pill — extracted from the
// hand-rolled staleness/live pills in dnsblockd's dashboard and three other
// consumers (2026-10-10 analysis, TODO_LIST #392).
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// StatusTone is the semantic color of a status indicator.
type StatusTone string

// Status tone constants.
const (
	// StatusToneNeutral is gray — connecting, paused, inert. The zero value.
	StatusToneNeutral StatusTone = "neutral"
	// StatusToneSuccess is green — live, online, healthy.
	StatusToneSuccess StatusTone = "success"
	// StatusToneWarning is amber — stale, reconnecting, waiting.
	StatusToneWarning StatusTone = "warning"
	// StatusToneDanger is red — offline, failed.
	StatusToneDanger StatusTone = "danger"
	// StatusToneInfo is blue — informational state.
	StatusToneInfo StatusTone = "info"
)

// StatusToneIsValid reports whether t is one of the defined tones. Unknown
// tones render neutral (graceful degradation).
func StatusToneIsValid(t StatusTone) bool {
	return t == StatusToneNeutral || t == StatusToneSuccess || t == StatusToneWarning ||
		t == StatusToneDanger || t == StatusToneInfo
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for tone background classes
var statusToneBgMap = map[StatusTone]string{
	StatusToneNeutral: "bg-gray-400 dark:bg-gray-500",
	StatusToneSuccess: "bg-green-500 dark:bg-green-400",
	StatusToneWarning: "bg-amber-500 dark:bg-amber-400",
	StatusToneDanger:  "bg-red-500 dark:bg-red-400",
	StatusToneInfo:    "bg-blue-500 dark:bg-blue-400",
}

// statusToneBg resolves the tone's background class (neutral fallback).
func statusToneBg(tone StatusTone) string {
	return utils.Lookup(statusToneBgMap, tone, statusToneBgMap[StatusToneNeutral])
}

// StatusDotProps configures a standalone status dot.
type StatusDotProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Tone selects the semantic color (neutral gray by default).
	Tone StatusTone
	// Pulse renders the radiating ring — live indicators. The zero value
	// is a static dot; the animation carries a motion-reduce fallback.
	Pulse bool
	// Label, when set, renders screen-reader text naming the state — a
	// colored dot that is the ONLY status indicator must be announced.
	// Without a Label the dot renders aria-hidden (decorative next to
	// visible text you provide).
	Label string
}

// DefaultStatusDotProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultStatusDotProps() StatusDotProps {
	return StatusDotProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // intentionally minimal defaults
		Tone: StatusToneNeutral,
	}
}

// LivePillProps configures the dot+text status pill.
type LivePillProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Tone selects the dot's semantic color.
	Tone StatusTone
	// Text is the visible label ("Live", "Reconnecting…").
	Text string
	// Pulse renders the radiating ring on the pill's dot.
	Pulse bool
}

// DefaultLivePillProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultLivePillProps() LivePillProps {
	return LivePillProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // intentionally minimal defaults
		Tone: StatusToneSuccess,
		Text: "Live",
	}
}
package display

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// statusDotSize is the standalone dot diameter (10px).
const statusDotSize = "h-2.5 w-2.5"

// statusPillDotSize is the pill's dot diameter (6px, dnsblockd's size).
const statusPillDotSize = "h-1.5 w-1.5"

// StatusDot renders a colored status dot, optionally pulsing.
//
//	@display.StatusDot(display.StatusDotProps{Tone: display.StatusToneSuccess, Pulse: true, Label: "Live"})
//
// Without a Label the dot is decorative (aria-hidden) — pair it with your
// own visible text.
//
// The wrapper owns the size and the layers inside it fill it (h-full w-full),
// so BaseProps.Class resizes the whole dot — including the pulse ring — rather
// than stretching an outer box around a dot stuck at the default diameter.
templ StatusDot(props StatusDotProps) {
	<span
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("relative inline-flex " + statusDotSize, props.Class) }
		if props.Label != "" {
			role="status"
		} else {
			aria-hidden="true"
		}
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.Pulse {
			<span class={ "absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full opacity-75 motion-reduce:animate-none " + statusToneBg(props.Tone) }></span>
		}
		<span class={ "relative inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full " + statusToneBg(props.Tone) }></span>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<span class="sr-only">{ props.Label }</span>
		}
	</span>
}

// LivePill renders the dot+text status pill — "Live", "Reconnecting…",
// "Paused" — the dashboard connection indicator shape.
//
//	@display.LivePill(display.LivePillProps{Tone: display.StatusToneSuccess, Text: "Live", Pulse: true})
templ LivePill(props LivePillProps) {
	<span
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-400", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<span class={ "relative inline-flex " + statusPillDotSize } aria-hidden="true">
			if props.Pulse {
				<span class={ "absolute inline-flex " + statusPillDotSize + " animate-ping rounded-full opacity-75 motion-reduce:animate-none " + statusToneBg(props.Tone) }></span>
			}
			<span class={ "relative inline-flex " + statusPillDotSize + " rounded-full " + statusToneBg(props.Tone) }></span>
		</span>
		{ props.Text }
	</span>
}
// Package display provides data display components like Table, Card, Badge, and Tabs.
package display

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// TableCell represents a single cell in a table row.
// When Content is set, it takes priority over Text for rendering.
type TableCell struct {
	Text    string
	Content templ.Component
}

// SortDirection defines the sort order for a table column.
type SortDirection string

const (
	SortNone SortDirection = ""
	SortAsc  SortDirection = "asc"
	SortDesc SortDirection = "desc"
)

// TableHeader defines a typed column header with optional sort capabilities.
// When TypedHeaders is set on TableProps, it takes precedence over Headers.
type TableHeader struct {
	Label         string
	Sortable      bool
	SortDirection SortDirection
	Href          string // When set with Sortable=true, renders as <a> for server-side sorting
}

// ariaSortValue maps SortDirection to the WAI-ARIA aria-sort attribute value.
func ariaSortValue(d SortDirection) string {
	switch d {
	case SortAsc:
		return "ascending"
	case SortDesc:
		return "descending"
	default:
		return "none"
	}
}

// sortIndicator returns the visual indicator character for a sort direction.
func sortIndicator(d SortDirection) string {
	switch d {
	case SortAsc:
		return " \u2191" // ↑
	case SortDesc:
		return " \u2193" // ↓
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func tableBorderedClass(bordered bool) string {
	if bordered {
		return "border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
	}
	return ""
}

// tableWrapperClass returns the class string for the table's scroll wrapper div.
// When flush is true (table nested in a Card with CardPaddingNone), the border
// and rounded corners are suppressed so the table sits flush against the card
// shell — avoiding the double-border defect. The overflow-x-auto scroll
// wrapper is always retained.
func tableWrapperClass(flush bool) string {
	if flush {
		return "overflow-x-auto"
	}
	return "overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
}

// TableCellPadding controls the vertical density of header and body cells.
type TableCellPadding string

const (
	// TableCellPaddingComfortable is the default cell padding (px-4 py-3) —
	// suitable for general-purpose tables and content pages.
	TableCellPaddingComfortable TableCellPadding = "comfortable"
	// TableCellPaddingCompact reduces vertical padding (px-4 py-2) for
	// data-heavy dashboards and admin panels where rows should feel tighter.
	TableCellPaddingCompact TableCellPadding = "compact"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for table cell padding
var tableCellPaddingLookup = map[TableCellPadding]string{
	TableCellPaddingComfortable: "px-4 py-3",
	TableCellPaddingCompact:     "px-4 py-2",
}

// tableCellPaddingClass returns the padding classes for the given cell padding,
// falling back to comfortable when unset or invalid.
func tableCellPaddingClass(p TableCellPadding) string {
	return utils.Lookup(tableCellPaddingLookup, p, tableCellPaddingLookup[TableCellPaddingComfortable])
}

// TableRow represents a single row in a table.
// When Href is set, the row becomes clickable (navigates on click/Enter).
// A CSP-safe singleton script handles click delegation and keyboard navigation.
// Clicks on interactive elements inside the row (links, buttons) are not hijacked.
//
// The row carries tabindex="0" and a focus-visible outline but NO role: ARIA in
// HTML forbids role (including role="link") on a <tr> inside a real table, and
// the validator rejected every page using it. Row.Href is therefore a
// pointer/keyboard convenience on top of the row content — keep the row's own
// link (an <a> in a cell) as the accessible navigation target for screen
// readers and for users who never press Enter.
type TableRow struct {
	Cells []TableCell
	// Href, when non-empty, makes the entire row clickable. The row gets
	// data-tc-row-href, tabindex="0", cursor-pointer, and a focus-visible
	// outline (browsers draw no default focus ring on a <tr>).
	Href string
	// Class, when set, is merged onto the row's <tr> (consumer classes last,
	// tailwind-merge resolves conflicts). Use it for per-row styling — e.g.
	// a hover treatment on a Body-less table without flipping Table.Hover
	// for every row, or a status tint on specific rows — without the
	// dummy-Href hack of borrowing the clickable-row styling.
	Class string
}

// SimpleTableRow creates a row from string values for convenience
func SimpleTableRow(values ...string) TableRow {
	r := TableRow{Cells: make([]TableCell, len(values))}
	for i, v := range values {
		r.Cells[i] = TableCell{Text: v}
	}
	return r
}

// tableRowCells returns cells for a row, padded or truncated to match
// the header count. If headers is 0, returns cells as-is.
func tableRowCells(row TableRow, headerCount int) []TableCell {
	if headerCount == 0 {
		return row.Cells
	}
	cells := row.Cells
	if len(cells) >= headerCount {
		return cells[:headerCount]
	}
	padded := make([]TableCell, headerCount)
	copy(padded, cells)
	return padded
}

// tableHasRowHref reports whether any row in the slice has Href set.
// Used to conditionally include the singleton click-delegation script.
func tableHasRowHref(rows []TableRow) bool {
	for _, r := range rows {
		if r.Href != "" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// tableRowClasses returns the merged class string for one body row:
// the conditional library classes (lazy-load, striped, hover, focus) plus the
// consumer's row.Class last so tailwind-merge resolves conflicts.
//
// Clickable rows carry a focus-visible outline: browsers draw no default focus
// ring on a <tr>, so without it a keyboard user cannot see which row Enter will
// activate (WCAG 2.4.7).
func tableRowClasses(props TableProps, row TableRow, index int) string {
	return utils.Class(
		utils.Ternary(props.LazyRows && props.CellPadding != TableCellPaddingCompact, "tc-content-auto", ""),
		utils.Ternary(props.LazyRows && props.CellPadding == TableCellPaddingCompact, "tc-content-auto-compact", ""),
		utils.Ternary(props.Striped && index%2 == 1, "bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50", ""),
		utils.Ternary(props.Hover || row.Href != "", "hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800", ""),
		utils.Ternary(row.Href != "", "cursor-pointer", ""),
		utils.Ternary(
			row.Href != "",
			"focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent-600 dark:focus-visible:outline-accent-400 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2",
			"",
		),
		row.Class,
	)
}

// tableHeaderCount returns the number of headers to align cells against.
// TypedHeaders takes precedence over Headers when set.
func tableHeaderCount(props TableProps) int {
	if len(props.TypedHeaders) > 0 {
		return len(props.TypedHeaders)
	}
	return len(props.Headers)
}

// TableProps configures a data table
type TableProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Caption      string
	Headers      []string
	TypedHeaders []TableHeader // When set, takes precedence over Headers for sortable column rendering
	Rows         []TableRow
	Striped      bool
	Hover        bool
	Bordered     bool
	// Flush, when true, suppresses the wrapper div's border and rounded corners.
	// Use this when the table is nested inside a Card(CardPaddingNone) to avoid
	// a double border — the card provides the outer border, and the table sits
	// flush against it. The overflow-x-auto scroll wrapper is always retained.
	Flush bool
	// StickyHeader, when true, pins the header row to the top of the table's
	// scroll container (sticky top-0 + z). Effective when the table scrolls
	// vertically — inside a height-constrained wrapper or a scrollable
	// ancestor (the built-in overflow-x-auto wrapper counts as a scroll
	// container). Harmless no-op on short tables.
	StickyHeader bool
	// CellPadding controls the vertical density of header and body cells.
	// Defaults to TableCellPaddingComfortable (px-4 py-3). Set to
	// TableCellPaddingCompact (px-4 py-2) for data-heavy dashboards and admin
	// panels where rows should feel tighter.
	CellPadding TableCellPadding
	// LazyRows, when true, applies content-visibility: auto to body rows.
	// The browser skips rendering off-screen rows, giving 2-5x faster initial
	// render for tables with 100+ rows. Uses contain-intrinsic-size so the
	// scrollbar stays accurate. Recommended for large data tables.
	LazyRows bool
	// Body, when set, overrides Rows for the <tbody> content. The component
	// should render <tr> elements directly — ideal for templ loops where each
	// row needs custom cell rendering:
	//
	//	@display.Table(display.TableProps{
	//	    Headers: headers,
	//	    Body:    messageRows(messages),
	//	})
	//	templ messageRows(messages []Message) {
	//	    for _, m := range messages {
	//	        <tr><td>{ m.Text }</td><td>{ m.Author }</td></tr>
	//	    }
	//	}
	Body templ.Component
	// BodyID, when non-empty, sets the id attribute on the <tbody> element.
	// Use on live-updating dashboards whose scripts swap rows without
	// querying the table's internal structure — so a markup refactor inside
	// the table cannot break the script's selector.
	BodyID string
}

// DefaultTableProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultTableProps() TableProps {
	return TableProps{
		Striped: true,
	}
}

// Table renders a responsive data table
//
//	@display.Table(display.TableProps{
//	   Headers: []string{"Name", "Email", "Role"},
//	   Rows: []display.TableRow{
//	     display.SimpleTableRow("Alice", "alice@example.com", "Admin"),
//	     display.SimpleTableRow("Bob", "bob@example.com", "User"),
//	   },
//	})
//
// For custom cell rendering, set Body to a component that renders <tr> elements
// directly — see the Body field on TableProps.
templ Table(props TableProps) {
	// tabindex="0" keeps an overflowing table keyboard-scrollable (WCAG 2.1
	// scrollable-region rule); the same pattern the Carousel track uses.
	// role="region" + accessible name (from AriaLabel, else Caption) expose
	// the scrollable wrapper as a named landmark; unnamed regions stay valid
	// (they simply do not appear in landmark rotors, matching prior behavior).
	{{ regionLabel := props.AriaLabel
	   if regionLabel == "" {
	   	regionLabel = props.Caption
	   } }}
	<div class={ tableWrapperClass(props.Flush) } tabindex="0" role="region" if regionLabel != "" { aria-label={ regionLabel } }>
		<table
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700 text-sm", tableBorderedClass(props.Bordered), props.Class) }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			if props.Caption != "" {
				<caption class="sr-only">{ props.Caption }</caption>
			}
			if len(props.Headers) > 0 || len(props.TypedHeaders) > 0 {
				<thead class={ utils.Ternary(props.StickyHeader, "sticky top-0 z-10 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800", "bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800") }>
					<tr>
						if len(props.TypedHeaders) > 0 {
							for _, th := range props.TypedHeaders {
								<th
									scope="col"
									if th.Sortable {
										aria-sort={ ariaSortValue(th.SortDirection) }
									}
									class={ utils.Class(tableCellPaddingClass(props.CellPadding), "text-start font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white") }
								>
									if th.Sortable && th.Href != "" {
										<a href={ templ.SafeURL(th.Href) } class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 py-1 hover:text-accent-600 dark:hover:text-accent-400">
											{ th.Label }{ sortIndicator(th.SortDirection) }
										</a>
									} else {
										{ th.Label }{ sortIndicator(th.SortDirection) }
									}
								</th>
							}
						} else {
							for _, h := range props.Headers {
								<th
									scope="col"
									class={ utils.Class(tableCellPaddingClass(props.CellPadding), "text-start font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white") }
								>
									{ h }
								</th>
							}
						}
					</tr>
				</thead>
			}
			<tbody
				if props.BodyID != "" {
					id={ props.BodyID }
				}
				class="divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900"
			>
				if props.Body != nil {
					@props.Body
				} else {
					for i, row := range props.Rows {
						<tr
							if row.Href != "" {
								data-tc-row-href={ row.Href }
								tabindex="0"
							}
							class={ tableRowClasses(props, row, i) }
						>
							for _, cell := range tableRowCells(row, tableHeaderCount(props)) {
								<td class={ utils.Class(tableCellPaddingClass(props.CellPadding), "text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300") }>
									if cell.Content != nil {
										@cell.Content
									} else {
										{ cell.Text }
									}
								</td>
							}
						</tr>
					}
				}
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
	if tableHasRowHref(props.Rows) {
		@tableRowHrefScriptComponent(props.Nonce)
	}
}
package display

import (
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// DataTableColumn defines a column in a DataTable with sort configuration.
type DataTableColumn struct {
	Label    string
	Sortable bool
	// SortKey is the query-param value representing this column when sorting
	// (e.g. "created_at"). When empty, defaults to the lowercase Label.
	SortKey string
}

// DataTableProps configures a data table with integrated sort management,
// optional pagination, and empty-state rendering. It composes Table internally,
// computing TypedHeaders with correct sort URLs from the current sort state.
//
// Consumers provide column definitions and the current sort state (read from
// URL query params on the server). DataTable generates the correct sort-toggle
// links for each header automatically.
type DataTableProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Columns []DataTableColumn
	Rows    []TableRow
	// ActiveSortColumn is the Label of the currently sorted column.
	ActiveSortColumn string
	// ActiveSortDir is the current sort direction of the active column.
	ActiveSortDir SortDirection
	// SortBaseURL is the base URL for sort links (e.g. "/users").
	// Query params for sort/dir are appended automatically.
	SortBaseURL string
	// SortParam is the query-parameter name for the sort column (default: "sort").
	SortParam string
	// DirParam is the query-parameter name for the sort direction (default: "dir").
	DirParam string
	// Pagination, when set, renders below the table. Pass a
	// navigation.Pagination component or any custom pager.
	Pagination templ.Component
	// EmptyState, when set and Rows is empty, replaces the table entirely.
	EmptyState templ.Component
	// Striped, Hover, Bordered — table appearance options (passed to Table).
	Striped  bool
	Hover    bool
	Bordered bool
	// Flush suppresses the table wrapper border — use when nesting inside
	// a Card(CardPaddingNone) to avoid double borders.
	Flush bool
	// CellPadding controls vertical density (passed to Table).
	CellPadding TableCellPadding
	// Caption is an accessibility-only table caption (visually hidden).
	Caption string
}

// DefaultDataTableProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultDataTableProps() DataTableProps {
	return DataTableProps{
		Striped:   true,
		SortParam: "sort",
		DirParam:  "dir",
	}
}

// toggleSortDir reverses the sort direction for header-click toggling.
func toggleSortDir(d SortDirection) SortDirection {
	if d == SortAsc {
		return SortDesc
	}
	return SortAsc
}

// columnSortKey returns the sort key for a column, defaulting to lowercase Label.
func columnSortKey(col DataTableColumn) string {
	if col.SortKey != "" {
		return col.SortKey
	}
	return strings.ToLower(col.Label)
}

// dataTableSortURL builds a sort URL: baseURL?sortParam=sortKey&dirParam=direction.
func dataTableSortURL(baseURL, sortParam, sortKey string, direction SortDirection, dirParam string) string {
	if baseURL == "" {
		return ""
	}
	params := url.Values{}
	params.Set(sortParam, sortKey)
	params.Set(dirParam, string(direction))
	sep := "?"
	if strings.Contains(baseURL, "?") {
		sep = "&"
	}
	return baseURL + sep + params.Encode()
}

// dataTableTypedHeaders computes TypedHeaders from columns + sort state.
// The active column gets its current direction and a toggle link.
// Other sortable columns get an ascending-sort link.
func dataTableTypedHeaders(props DataTableProps) []TableHeader {
	sortParam := props.SortParam
	if sortParam == "" {
		sortParam = "sort"
	}
	dirParam := props.DirParam
	if dirParam == "" {
		dirParam = "dir"
	}
	headers := make([]TableHeader, len(props.Columns))
	for i, col := range props.Columns {
		h := TableHeader{
			Label:    col.Label,
			Sortable: col.Sortable,
		}
		if col.Sortable && props.SortBaseURL != "" {
			key := columnSortKey(col)
			if col.Label == props.ActiveSortColumn {
				h.SortDirection = props.ActiveSortDir
				h.Href = dataTableSortURL(
					props.SortBaseURL, sortParam, key,
					toggleSortDir(props.ActiveSortDir), dirParam,
				)
			} else {
				h.Href = dataTableSortURL(
					props.SortBaseURL, sortParam, key,
					SortAsc, dirParam,
				)
			}
		}
		headers[i] = h
	}
	return headers
}

// DataTable renders a data table with integrated sort management, optional
// pagination, and empty-state handling. It composes the Table component
// internally, generating correct sort-toggle URLs for each column header.
//
//	@display.DataTable(display.DataTableProps{
//	   Columns: []display.DataTableColumn{
//	     {Label: "Name", Sortable: true},
//	     {Label: "Email", Sortable: true, SortKey: "email_address"},
//	     {Label: "Role"},
//	   },
//	   Rows: []display.TableRow{
//	     display.SimpleTableRow("Alice", "alice@example.com", "Admin"),
//	     display.SimpleTableRow("Bob", "bob@example.com", "User"),
//	   },
//	   ActiveSortColumn: "Name",
//	   ActiveSortDir:    display.SortAsc,
//	   SortBaseURL:      "/users",
//	})
templ DataTable(props DataTableProps) {
	{{ hasRows := len(props.Rows) > 0 }}
	if hasRows {
		@Table(TableProps{
			BaseProps:    props.BaseProps,
			Caption:      props.Caption,
			TypedHeaders: dataTableTypedHeaders(props),
			Rows:         props.Rows,
			Striped:      props.Striped,
			Hover:        props.Hover,
			Bordered:     props.Bordered,
			Flush:        props.Flush,
			CellPadding:  props.CellPadding,
		})
	} else if props.EmptyState != nil {
		@props.EmptyState
	} else {
		@Table(TableProps{
			BaseProps:    props.BaseProps,
			Caption:      props.Caption,
			TypedHeaders: dataTableTypedHeaders(props),
			Rows:         props.Rows,
			Striped:      props.Striped,
			Hover:        props.Hover,
			Bordered:     props.Bordered,
			Flush:        props.Flush,
			CellPadding:  props.CellPadding,
		})
	}
	if hasRows && props.Pagination != nil {
		<div class="mt-4">
			@props.Pagination
		</div>
	}
}
package display

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// Tab represents a single tab panel
type Tab struct {
	ID      string
	Label   string
	Content templ.Component
}

// TabsVariant defines the visual style of tabs
type TabsVariant string

const (
	TabsDefault TabsVariant = "default"
	TabsPills   TabsVariant = "pills"
)

// TabsProps configures a tab component
type TabsProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Tabs        []Tab
	ActiveTabID string
	Variant     TabsVariant
	ClientSide  bool
	// Wire, when set, switches the tabs from client-side toggling to
	// SERVER-side switching: each tab link carries the wired action with the
	// URL's `{tab}` placeholder substituted by that tab's ID (the same
	// URL-template convention as the Calendar MonthNav `{year}`/`{month}`),
	// and the endpoint re-renders the WHOLE Tabs component with the new
	// ActiveTabID. Under htmx the action self-replaces the container with
	// `outerHTML settle:0s` (the Calendar re-bind-window rationale: without
	// settle, rapid tab clicks land in htmx's ~20ms processing window and
	// silently no-op); under Datastar targeting is response-driven
	// (wire.Handler) or id-matched — give the fragment root the Tabs' id.
	// An empty Wire.Target defaults to the component's own `#ID` when ID is
	// set. Wire is nil-safe inert: an empty URL wires nothing. ClientSide is
	// ignored when Wire is set (one switching model at a time); the anchors'
	// hash hrefs remain as the no-JS fallback, so the clone sets
	// PreventDefault (the Datastar runtime auto-prevents only form+submit).
	Wire *wire.Action
}

// DefaultTabsProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultTabsProps() TabsProps {
	return TabsProps{
		Variant: TabsDefault,
	}
}

// isActiveTab returns true if the given tab ID matches the active tab
func isActiveTab(tabID, activeTabID string) bool {
	return tabID == activeTabID && tabID != ""
}

// ensureTabIDs generates stable IDs for tabs that omit them, preventing
// invalid HTML (duplicate id="" attributes) and JS selector crashes in
// client-side mode.
func ensureTabIDs(tabs []Tab) []Tab {
	for i := range tabs {
		if tabs[i].ID == "" {
			tabs[i].ID = utils.EnsureID("tab", "")
		}
	}
	return tabs
}

// resolveActiveTabID returns activeTabID if set, otherwise defaults to the
// first tab so that exactly one tab is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0) per
// the WAI-ARIA tab pattern.
func resolveActiveTabID(activeTabID string, tabs []Tab) string {
	if activeTabID != "" {
		return activeTabID
	}
	if len(tabs) > 0 {
		return tabs[0].ID
	}
	return ""
}

// tabLink renders a single tab link with the given class based on active state.
// aria-controls is emitted only when the tab owns a panel — referencing a
// non-existent id is an axe aria-valid-attr-value violation. wired carries
// the per-tab transport attributes when TabsProps.Wire is set (nil renders
// nothing — the plain hash-fallback anchor).
templ tabLink(tab Tab, hasPanel bool, isActive bool, activeClass, inactiveClass string, wired templ.Attributes) {
	<a
		id={ tab.ID + "-tab" }
		href={ templ.SafeURL("#" + tab.ID) }
		role="tab"
		aria-selected={ fmt.Sprintf("%t", isActive) }
		if hasPanel {
			aria-controls={ tab.ID }
		}
		tabindex={ utils.Ternary(isActive, 0, -1) }
		class={ utils.Ternary(isActive, activeClass, inactiveClass) }
		{ wired... }
	>
		{ tab.Label }
	</a>
}

// tabsWiredAttrs clones the Wire action for one tab (never mutating the
// consumer's spec — the kanban lesson): the URL's {tab} placeholder becomes
// that tab's ID, the anchor-fallback href forces PreventDefault (the Datastar
// runtime auto-prevents only form+submit; htmx intercepts wired clicks
// itself), an empty Target defaults to the Tabs container's own #ID, and htmx
// gets the settle:0s self-swap composed on top. Nil/empty stays inert.
func tabsWiredAttrs(base *wire.Action, tabID, tabsID string) templ.Attributes {
	if base == nil || base.URL == "" {
		return nil
	}

	nav := *base
	nav.URL = strings.ReplaceAll(base.URL, "{tab}", tabID)
	nav.PreventDefault = true
	if nav.Target == "" && tabsID != "" {
		nav.Target = "#" + tabsID
	}

	attrs := nav.Attributes()
	if attrs != nil && nav.Transport != wire.TransportDatastar {
		attrs["hx-swap"] = tabsSwap
	}

	return attrs
}

// tabsSwap self-replaces the whole Tabs container and settles synchronously —
// htmx processes swapped-in anchors in its settle phase (~20ms by default);
// tab switching is exactly the quick-burst pattern where a click inside that
// window would silently no-op (Calendar MonthNav lesson, e2e-verified there).
const tabsSwap = "outerHTML settle:0s"

// Tabs renders a tabbed interface with accessible markup
//
//	@display.Tabs(display.TabsProps{
//	   ActiveTabID: "users",
//	   Tabs: []display.Tab{
//	     {ID: "users", Label: "Users"},
//	     {ID: "settings", Label: "Settings"},
//	   },
//	})
templ Tabs(props TabsProps) {
	{{ tabs := ensureTabIDs(props.Tabs) }}
	{{ activeID := resolveActiveTabID(props.ActiveTabID, tabs) }}
	{{ clientSide := props.ClientSide && props.Wire == nil }}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("w-full", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		if clientSide {
			data-tc-tabs=""
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div role="tablist" aria-label="Tabs" class="border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
			<div
				class={ "-mb-px flex space-x-8", templ.KV("space-x-2", props.Variant == TabsPills) }
			>
				for _, tab := range tabs {
					{{ active := isActiveTab(tab.ID, activeID) }}
					{{ wired := tabsWiredAttrs(props.Wire, tab.ID, props.ID) }}
					if props.Variant == TabsPills {
						@tabLink(tab, tab.Content != nil, active,
							"rounded-md bg-accent-600 dark:bg-accent-500 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white",
							"rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:text-gray-200",
							wired,
						)
					} else {
						@tabLink(tab, tab.Content != nil, active,
							"whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 border-accent-500 px-1 py-4 text-sm font-medium text-accent-600 dark:text-accent-400",
							"whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 border-transparent px-1 py-4 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:border-gray-300 hover:text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:border-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-200",
							wired,
						)
					}
				}
			</div>
		</div>
		for _, tab := range tabs {
			if tab.Content != nil {
				<div
					id={ tab.ID }
					role="tabpanel"
					aria-labelledby={ tab.ID + "-tab" }
					if !isActiveTab(tab.ID, activeID) {
						hidden
					}
					class="mt-4"
				>
					@tab.Content
				</div>
			}
		}
		if clientSide {
			<script { utils.ScriptAttrs(props.Nonce)... }>
				if (!window.tcTabsAttached) {
					window.tcTabsAttached = true;
					document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
						var link = e.target.closest('[data-tc-tabs] [role="tab"]');
						if (!link) return;
						e.preventDefault();
						activateTab(link);
					});
					document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
						var tab = e.target.closest('[data-tc-tabs] [role="tab"]');
						if (!tab) return;
						var tabs = Array.from(tab.closest('[role="tablist"]').querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'));
						var idx = tabs.indexOf(tab);
						var next = -1;
						var rtl = (tab.closest('[dir]') || document.documentElement).getAttribute('dir') === 'rtl';
						var nextKey = rtl ? 'ArrowLeft' : 'ArrowRight';
						var prevKey = rtl ? 'ArrowRight' : 'ArrowLeft';
						if (e.key === nextKey || e.key === 'ArrowDown') { next = (idx + 1) % tabs.length; }
						else if (e.key === prevKey || e.key === 'ArrowUp') { next = (idx - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length; }
						else if (e.key === 'Home') { next = 0; }
						else if (e.key === 'End') { next = tabs.length - 1; }
						if (next >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); tabs[next].focus(); activateTab(tabs[next]); }
					});
				}
				function activateTab(link) {
					var container = link.closest('[data-tc-tabs]');
					container.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').forEach(function(t) {
						t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');
						t.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');
					});
					link.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
					link.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
					container.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]').forEach(function(p) { p.hidden = true; });
					var panel = container.querySelector('#' + link.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
					if (panel) panel.hidden = false;
				}
			</script>
		}
	</div>
}

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// TooltipProps configures a tooltip component.
//
// The tooltip shows on :hover and :focus-within via pure CSS. A tiny
// singleton script (tooltipAriaScriptComponent) propagates aria-describedby
// from the non-focusable wrapper <div> to the first focusable child so
// screen readers announce the tooltip text on focus.
type TooltipProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Text     string
	Position TooltipPosition
}

// DefaultTooltipProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultTooltipProps() TooltipProps {
	return TooltipProps{
		Position: TooltipPositionTop,
	}
}

type tooltipPositionStyles struct {
	Tooltip string
	Arrow   string
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for tooltip position styles
var tooltipPositionMap = map[Position]tooltipPositionStyles{
	PositionTop: {
		Tooltip: "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2",
		Arrow:   "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-t-gray-900 dark:border-t-gray-700",
	},
	PositionBottom: {
		Tooltip: "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2",
		Arrow:   "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-b-gray-900 dark:border-b-gray-700",
	},
	PositionStart: {
		Tooltip: "inset-e-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 me-2",
		Arrow:   "inset-s-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-s-gray-900 dark:border-s-gray-700",
	},
	PositionEnd: {
		Tooltip: "inset-s-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ms-2",
		Arrow:   "inset-e-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-e-gray-900 dark:border-e-gray-700",
	},
	PositionLeft: {
		Tooltip: "right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 me-2",
		Arrow:   "left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-s-gray-900 dark:border-s-gray-700",
	},
	PositionRight: {
		Tooltip: "left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ms-2",
		Arrow:   "right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-e-gray-900 dark:border-e-gray-700",
	},
}

func tooltipLookupPosition(pos TooltipPosition) tooltipPositionStyles {
	return utils.Lookup(tooltipPositionMap, pos, tooltipPositionMap[PositionTop])
}

// Tooltip wraps content in a hover/focus-activated tooltip. Pure CSS for
// show/hide (group-hover/group-focus-within); a singleton script propagates
// aria-describedby to the focusable trigger for screen-reader support.
//
//	@display.Tooltip(display.TooltipProps{Text: "More info"}) {
//	   <button>Hover me</button>
//	}
templ Tooltip(props TooltipProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("tooltip", props.ID) }}
	{{ pos := tooltipLookupPosition(props.Position) }}
	<div
		id={ id }
		data-tc-tooltip
		data-tc-position={ string(props.Position) }
		class={ utils.Class("group relative inline-flex", props.Class) }
		aria-describedby={ id + "-tooltip" }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
		<div
			id={ id + "-tooltip" }
			class={ "absolute z-20 hidden group-hover:block group-focus-within:block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-gray-900 dark:bg-gray-700 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-white shadow-xs",
				pos.Tooltip }
			role="tooltip"
		>
			{ props.Text }
			<div class={ "absolute h-0 w-0 border-4 border-transparent", pos.Arrow }></div>
		</div>
	</div>
	@tooltipAriaScriptComponent(props.Nonce)
}

								<a
									href={ templ.SafeURL(wayOutHref) }
									class={ errorActionClassScaffold + "shadow-sm " + utils.TransitionColors + " focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2", style.ActionButton }
								>
									@actionLinkBody(utils.Coalesce(wayOutText, "Go back"))
								</a>
							} else if wayOutText != "" {
								<button
									type="button"
									data-tc-go-back
									class={ errorActionClassScaffold + "shadow-sm " + utils.TransitionColors + " focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2", style.ActionButton }
								>
									{ props.WayOut }
								</button>
							}
							if props.SecondaryWayOut != "" {
								if props.SecondaryWayOutHref != "" {
									<a
										href={ templ.SafeURL(props.SecondaryWayOutHref) }
										class={ errorActionClassScaffold + "border " + utils.TransitionColors + " focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2", style.ActionButtonGhost }
									>
										{ props.SecondaryWayOut }
									</a>
								} else {
									<button
										type="button"
										data-tc-go-back
										class={ errorActionClassScaffold + "border " + utils.TransitionColors + " focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2", style.ActionButtonGhost }
									>
										{ props.SecondaryWayOut }
									</button>
								}
							}
						</div>
					}
				</div>
				if props.ShowTimestamp || props.Trace != "" {
					@metaFooter(props.Timestamp, props.Trace, "px-6 py-3.5 sm:px-10 bg-gray-50/60 dark:bg-gray-900/40")
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	</main>
	if (wayOutText != "" && wayOutHref == "") || (props.SecondaryWayOut != "" && props.SecondaryWayOutHref == "") {
		@goBackScript(props.Nonce)
	}
	if props.CopyCode {
		@copyCodeScript(props.Nonce)
	}
}

templ NotFound404(props NotFound404Props) {
	{{
		numeral := props.Numeral
		if numeral == "" {
			numeral = notFound404DefaultNumeral
		}
	}}
	{{
		title := props.Title
		if title == "" {
			title = notFound404DefaultTitle
		}
	}}
	{{ goHomeHref := props.GoHomeHref }}
	{{
		goHomeText := props.GoHomeText
		if goHomeText == "" {
			goHomeText = notFound404GoHomeText
		}
	}}
	{{
		goBackText := props.GoBackText
		if goBackText == "" {
			goBackText = notFound404GoBackText
		}
	}}
	<main
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		} else {
			aria-label="404 — Page not found"
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div class="w-full max-w-xl text-center">
			<p
				class="text-[8rem] sm:text-[10rem] leading-none font-extrabold tracking-tighter bg-linear-to-br from-blue-600 via-blue-500 to-indigo-500 dark:from-blue-500 dark:via-blue-400 dark:to-indigo-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent select-none"
				aria-hidden="true"
			>{ numeral }</p>
			<h1 class="mt-4 text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ title }</h1>
			if props.Message != "" {
				<p class="mt-3 text-base text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 max-w-md mx-auto">{ props.Message }</p>
			}
			if props.SearchAction != "" {
				@notFound404Search(props)
			}
			<div class="mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
				if goHomeHref != "" {
					<a
						href={ templ.SafeURL(goHomeHref) }
						class={ errorActionClassScaffold + "bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-500 dark:hover:bg-blue-400 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 dark:focus-visible:ring-blue-400 " + utils.TransitionColors }
					>
						@actionLinkBody(goHomeText)
					</a>
				}
				if props.ShowGoBack {
					<button
						type="button"
						data-tc-go-back
						class={ errorActionClassScaffold + "border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-gray-400 dark:focus-visible:ring-gray-500 " + utils.TransitionColors }
					>
						@icons.IconRTL(icons.ArrowLeft, "h-4 w-4")
						<span>{ goBackText }</span>
					</button>
				}
			</div>
			if len(props.Links) > 0 {
				<div class="mt-10">
					<p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500">{ utils.Coalesce(props.LinksTitle, notFound404PopularLabel) }</p>
					<div class="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
						for _, link := range props.Links {
							<a
								href={ templ.SafeURL(link.Href) }
								class={ "group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 px-4 py-3 text-start hover:border-blue-400 dark:hover:border-blue-500 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 dark:focus-visible:ring-blue-400 " + utils.TransitionColors }
							>
								if link.Icon != "" {
									<span class={ "flex-shrink-0 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-500 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 " + utils.TransitionColors }>
										@icons.Icon(link.Icon, "h-5 w-5")
									</span>
								}
								<span class={ "text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 " + utils.TransitionColors }>{ link.Text }</span>
							</a>
						}
					</div>
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	</main>
	if props.ShowGoBack {
		@goBackScript(props.Nonce)
	}
}

templ notFound404Search(props NotFound404Props) {
	{{
		inputName := props.SearchInputName
		if inputName == "" {
			inputName = notFound404InputName
		}
	}}
	{{
		placeholder := props.SearchPlaceholder
		if placeholder == "" {
			placeholder = notFound404SearchDefault
		}
	}}
	{{
		submitLabel := props.SearchSubmitLabel
		if submitLabel == "" {
			submitLabel = notFound404SearchSubmitLabel
		}
	}}
	<form
		action={ templ.SafeURL(props.SearchAction) }
		method="get"
		class="mt-6 mx-auto max-w-md"
		role="search"
	>
		<div class="relative">
			<input
				type="search"
				name={ inputName }
				placeholder={ placeholder }
				class="block w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 ps-4 pe-14 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:outline-hidden dark:focus:border-blue-400 caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400 transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0"
				aria-label={ placeholder }
			/>
			<button
				type="submit"
				aria-label={ submitLabel }
				class={ "absolute inset-y-0 inset-e-0 my-auto me-1.5 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 dark:hover:text-gray-300 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 dark:focus-visible:ring-blue-400 " + utils.TransitionColors }
			>
				@icons.Icon(icons.Search, "h-5 w-5")
			</button>
		</div>
	</form>
}

templ familyIcon(style familyVisualStyle, iconClass string) {
	@icons.Icon(style.Icon, utils.Class(iconClass, style.IconColor))
}

// errorBody renders the badge + title + message block that lives inside the
// `flex-1 min-w-0` content column of an error header (ErrorDetail). The icon
// and outer flex wrapper stay at the call site because their layout (gap,
// icon container decoration) differs per visual density.
//
// Parameters:
//   - titleTag: heading element — "h1" for hero/full, "h3" for compact.
//   - titleClass: Tailwind classes for the heading (mt-N + text size).
//   - messageClass: Tailwind classes for the message paragraph.
templ errorBody(style familyVisualStyle, family Family, code Code, title, titleTag, titleClass, message, messageClass string) {
	@errorChips(0, family, style, code, false, "")
	if title != "" {
		switch titleTag {
			case "h1":
				<h1 class={ titleClass }>{ title }</h1>
			case "h3":
				<h3 class={ titleClass }>{ title }</h3>
		}
	}
	if message != "" {
		<p class={ messageClass }>{ message }</p>
	}
}

// errorHeader renders the complete icon + content header for the compact
// error display (ErrorDetail). ErrorPage uses its own stacked hero layout.
templ errorHeader(
	gap string,
	iconContainerClass string,
	style familyVisualStyle,
	family Family,
	code Code,
	title string,
	titleTag string,
	titleClass string,
	message string,
	messageClass string,
) {
	<div class={ "flex items-start", gap }>
		<div class={ iconContainerClass }>
			@familyIcon(style, "h-5 w-5")
		</div>
		<div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
			@errorBody(style, family, code, title, titleTag, titleClass, message, messageClass)
		</div>
	</div>
}

templ fixCard(fix string, insetClass string, describedBy string) {
	<div
		class={ utils.Class("rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-3", insetClass) }
		if describedBy != "" {
			aria-describedby={ describedBy }
		}
	>
		<p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500">
			<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
				@icons.Icon(icons.Wrench, "h-3.5 w-3.5")
				Suggested fix
			</span>
		</p>
		<p class="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">{ fix }</p>
	</div>
}

templ causeList(causes []CauseItem, label string) {
	if len(causes) > 0 {
		<div class="space-y-1">
			<p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">{ label }</p>
			for _, cause := range causes {
				<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
					<span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600 flex-shrink-0"></span>
					<span class="font-mono">{ cause.Message }</span>
					if cause.Code != "" {
						<span class="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">({ cause.Code })</span>
					}
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	}
}

templ contextTable(pairs []ContextPair, insetClass string, id string) {
	if len(pairs) > 0 {
		<div id={ id } class={ utils.Class("overflow-hidden rounded-lg border", insetClass) }>
			<table class="min-w-full text-xs">
				<caption class="sr-only">Error context</caption>
				<tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-700">
					for _, pair := range pairs {
						<tr>
							<th scope="row" class="px-3 py-1.5 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap w-1/4 text-start">{ pair.Key }</th>
							<td class="px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 break-all">{ pair.Value }</td>
						</tr>
					}
				</tbody>
			</table>
		</div>
	}
}

// metaFooter renders the footer strip with the timestamp and/or the error's
// correlation trace ID (support hand-off). Rendered only when at least one
// is set; each entry is guarded independently.
templ metaFooter(timestamp string, trace string, class string) {
	if timestamp != "" || trace != "" {
		<div class={ class, "flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800" }>
			if timestamp != "" {
				<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500">{ timestamp }</p>
			}
			if trace != "" {
				<p class="font-mono text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500">Trace: { trace }</p>
			}
		</div>
	}
}

// familyBadge renders the family name as a tinted chip. Zero-value and
// unknown families render nothing (graceful degradation, same policy as
// AvatarStatus) instead of an empty visible element.
templ familyBadge(family Family, style familyVisualStyle) {
	if FamilyIsValid(family) {
		<span class={ "inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium", style.AccentBG, style.AccentText }>
			{ string(family) }
		</span>
	}
}

// errorChips renders the metadata chip row: optional HTTP status code,
// optional error code, and the family badge. Every chip is guarded — a
// zero-value field renders nothing instead of an empty chip.
templ errorChips(statusCode int, family Family, style familyVisualStyle, code Code, copyCode bool, nonce string) {
	if statusCode > 0 || code != "" || FamilyIsValid(family) {
		<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
			if statusCode > 0 {
				<span class="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
					{ fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d", statusCode) }
				</span>
			}
			if code != "" {
				<code class={ "inline-flex items-center rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-medium", style.AccentBG, style.AccentText }>
					{ code }
				</code>
				if copyCode {
					<button
						type="button"
						data-tc-copy={ string(code) }
						aria-label={ "Copy error code " + string(code) }
						class={ "-m-1.5 inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 dark:hover:text-gray-300 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-gray-400 dark:focus-visible:ring-gray-500", utils.TransitionColors }
					>
						@icons.Icon(icons.Clipboard, "h-3.5 w-3.5")
					</button>
				}
			}
			@familyBadge(family, style)
		</div>
	}
}

// diagnosticSection renders the fix/context/cause diagnostic blocks. The
// containerClass owns the vertical rhythm (space-y); insetClass picks the
// panel surface for the current card background (errorInsetNeutral on the
// white ErrorPage card, errorInsetCard on tinted ErrorDetail cards).
templ diagnosticSection(fix string, context []ContextPair, causes []CauseItem, containerClass string, causeLabel string, insetClass string) {
	if fix != "" || len(context) > 0 || len(causes) > 0 {
		{{ ctxID := utils.EnsureID("error-context", "") }}
		<div class={ containerClass }>
			if fix != "" {
				@fixCard(fix, insetClass, utils.Ternary(len(context) > 0, ctxID, ""))
			}
			@contextTable(context, insetClass, ctxID)
			@causeList(causes, causeLabel)
		</div>
	}
}

// goBackScript renders the singleton history.back() delegation script shared
// by ErrorPage (WayOut button) and NotFound404 (ShowGoBack button). Both
// components use [data-tc-go-back] as the click target.
//
// Stays in errorpage until a second package needs history.back() — then
// promote to utils, following the DismissButton precedent (utils/dismiss.templ
// was promoted only when both feedback and errorpage needed the same markup).
templ goBackScript(nonce string) {
	<script { utils.ScriptAttrs(nonce)... }>
		if (!window.tcGoBackAttached) {
			window.tcGoBackAttached = true;
			document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				if (e.target.closest('[data-tc-go-back]')) history.back();
			});
		}
	</script>
}

// copyCodeScript renders the copy-to-clipboard singleton for the ErrorPage
// code chip. It deliberately shares display.CopyButton's contract AND its
// window.tcCopyAttached guard key: errorpage cannot import display (module
// cycle — display's root module imports errorpage), so the ~14-line listener
// is re-expressed here with identical [data-tc-copy] semantics; on a page
// that already carries display.CopyButton the guard makes whichever script
// loads first serve both (accepted clone per ADR-0009, module-boundary
// required).
templ copyCodeScript(nonce string) {
	<script { utils.ScriptAttrs(nonce)... }>
		if (!window.tcCopyAttached) {
			window.tcCopyAttached = true;
			document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				var btn = e.target.closest('[data-tc-copy]');
				if (!btn) return;
				e.preventDefault();
				var text = btn.getAttribute('data-tc-copy');
				if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
					navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
				} else {
					var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
					ta.value = text;
					ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:-9999px;left:-9999px';
					document.body.appendChild(ta);
					ta.select();
					try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (err) {}
					document.body.removeChild(ta);
				}
			});
		}
	</script>
}

// actionLinkBody renders the shared <span>text</span> + ArrowRight icon body
// used inside action <a> elements by ErrorPage and NotFound404.
templ actionLinkBody(text string) {
	<span>{ text }</span>
	@icons.IconRTL(icons.ArrowRight, "h-4 w-4")
}

// AlertProps configures an alert banner
type AlertProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Title       string
	Message     string
	Type        FeedbackType
	Dismissible bool
}

// DefaultAlertProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultAlertProps() AlertProps {
	return AlertProps{
		Type: FeedbackInfo,
	}
}

// Alert renders a full-width alert banner
//
//	@feedback.Alert(feedback.AlertProps{Title: "Error", Message: "Something went wrong", Type: feedback.FeedbackError})
//
// The ARIA role derives from Type: errors announce assertively
// (role="alert"); every other type reports politely (role="status") so a
// success banner is never read as an error by screen readers.
//
// The dismiss control markup is shared via utils.DismissButton; only the style
// classes differ from errorpage.ErrorAlert. JS behaviour is shared via
// utils.DismissScript().
templ Alert(props AlertProps) {
	{{ s := feedbackStyle(props.Type) }}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("rounded-md border p-4", s.Border, s.BG, props.Class) }
		role={ feedbackRole(props.Type) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div class="flex">
			<div class="flex-shrink-0">
				@icons.Icon(feedbackIcon(props.Type), utils.Class("h-5 w-5", s.Icon))
			</div>
			<div class="ms-3 flex-1">
				if props.Title != "" {
					<h3 class={ "text-sm font-medium", s.Text }>{ props.Title }</h3>
				}
				<div class={ "text-sm", s.Text }>
					<p>{ props.Message }</p>
					{ children... }
				</div>
			</div>
			if props.Dismissible {
				@utils.DismissButton(s.BG, s.Text)
			}
		</div>
		if props.Dismissible {
			@utils.ScriptComponent(props.Nonce, utils.DismissScript(), "alert dismiss script")
		}
	</div>
}

// inlineMessage renders a compact inline status message with icon
templ inlineMessage(message string, colorClass string, role string, icon templ.Component) {
	<div class={ "mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm", colorClass } role={ role } aria-live="polite">
		@icon
		<span>{ message }</span>
	</div>
}
