import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// TagsInputProps configures a tag input where users can add and remove tags.
// Tags are rendered as removable badges. Values are submitted as repeated
// hidden inputs with the given Name, so the server receives []string.
type TagsInputProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name           string
	Label          string
	Values         []string
	Placeholder    string
	MaxTags        int  // 0 = unlimited
	AllowDuplicate bool // false by default
	Required       bool
	Disabled       bool
	Error          string
	HelpText       string
}

// DefaultTagsInputProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultTagsInputProps() TagsInputProps {
	return TagsInputProps{} //nolint:exhaustruct // intentionally minimal
}

// tagsInputFallbackName is the accessible name for the TagsInput text field
// when the consumer set neither Label nor AriaLabel — a text input must never
// render unnamed (axe label).
const tagsInputFallbackName = "Add tag"

// tagsInputRemoveIconPath sources the remove-tag X glyph from the icons
// package's single source of truth (icons.X) for JS injection.
func tagsInputRemoveIconPath() string {
	return icons.IconPathData(icons.X)[0]
}

// tagsInputJS is the CSP-safe add/remove singleton script (ADR-0005); %s is
// the icons-sourced X path data.
const tagsInputJS = `
				(function(){if(window.tcTagsInputAttached)return;window.tcTagsInputAttached=true;
				document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
				var input=e.target;if(!input||!input.hasAttribute('data-tc-tags-input'))return;
				var container=input.closest('[data-tc-tags]');if(!container)return;
				// IME composition: Enter commits the composition, it does not add a
				// tag. isComposing is the standard signal; keyCode 229 covers engines
				// that only report the legacy code (Modern Web Guidance:
				// ime-safe-enter-submit).
				if(e.isComposing||e.keyCode===229)return;
				if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===','){e.preventDefault();
				var val=input.value.trim();if(!val)return;input.value='';
				var existing=container.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-tag]');
				if(!container.dataset.allowDuplicate){for(var i=0;i<existing.length;i++){if(existing[i].getAttribute('data-tc-tag')===val)return;}}
				var max=parseInt(container.dataset.maxTags||'0',10);if(max>0&&existing.length>=max)return;
				var span=document.createElement('span');span.className='inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300';span.setAttribute('data-tc-tag',val);span.textContent=val+' ';
				var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.className='p-1.5 -m-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 dark:hover:text-blue-200';btn.setAttribute('data-tc-tag-remove',val);btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+val);btn.innerHTML='<svg class="h-3 w-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="%s"></path></svg>';
				span.appendChild(btn);
				var hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name=container.getAttribute('data-tc-tags');hidden.value=val;
				container.insertBefore(span,input);container.insertBefore(hidden,input);}
				if(e.key==='Backspace'&&input.value===''){var tags=container.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-tag]');if(tags.length>0){var last=tags[tags.length-1];var v=last.getAttribute('data-tc-tag');last.remove();var hs=container.querySelectorAll('input[type=hidden][value="'+v+'"]');for(var j=0;j<hs.length;j++){hs[j].remove();}}}});
				document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var btn=e.target.closest('[data-tc-tag-remove]');if(!btn)return;e.preventDefault();var container=btn.closest('[data-tc-tags]');if(!container)return;var v=btn.getAttribute('data-tc-tag-remove');var tag=btn.closest('[data-tc-tag]');if(tag)tag.remove();var hs=container.querySelectorAll('input[type=hidden][value="'+v+'"]');for(var k=0;k<hs.length;k++){hs[k].remove();}});
				})();
			`

// tagsInputScriptComponent writes the tags-input script raw: templ's <script>
// context sanitizes interpolations, and the JS must land verbatim with the
// icons-sourced path data (same pattern as dirtyGuardScriptComponent). The
// script itself always renders so non-CSP consumers still get working tags;
// utils.ScriptComponent owns the omit-empty nonce rule and the CSP-safe
// write (nonce="" is rejected by strict-CSP pages — see utils.ScriptAttrs).
func tagsInputScriptComponent(nonce string) templ.Component {
	script := fmt.Sprintf(tagsInputJS, tagsInputRemoveIconPath())

	return utils.ScriptComponent(nonce, script, "tags input script")
}

// tagsInputContainerClass returns the container classes for the tags input.
func tagsInputContainerClass(hasError bool) string {
	base := "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 px-3 py-2 border-0 ring-1 ring-inset focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-inset transition-shadow motion-reduce:transition-none"
	if hasError {
		return base + " ring-red-300 dark:ring-red-700 focus-within:ring-red-500 dark:focus-within:ring-red-500"
	}
	return base + " ring-gray-300 dark:ring-gray-600 focus-within:ring-blue-600 dark:focus-within:ring-blue-500"
}

// TagsInput renders a tag input with add/remove functionality.
// Tags are submitted as repeated hidden inputs. A CSP-safe singleton script
// handles Enter-to-add, Backspace-to-delete-last, and remove-button clicks.
//
//	@forms.TagsInput(forms.TagsInputProps{
//	   Name:  "skills",
//	   Label: "Skills",
//	   Values: []string{"Go", "HTMX"},
//	   Placeholder: "Add a skill...",
//	})
templ TagsInput(props TagsInputProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("tags", props.ID) }}
	<div class={ utils.Class("space-y-1", props.Class) } { props.Attrs... }>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<label
				for={ id }
				class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
			>
				{ props.Label }
				if props.Required {
					<span class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 ms-0.5" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
				}
			</label>
		}
		<div
			class={ tagsInputContainerClass(props.Error != "") }
			data-tc-tags={ id }
			if props.MaxTags > 0 {
				data-max-tags={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.MaxTags) }
			}
			if props.AllowDuplicate {
				data-allow-duplicate="true"
			}
		>
			for _, val := range props.Values {
				<span
					class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300"
					data-tc-tag={ val }
				>
					{ val }
					<button
						type="button"
						class="p-1.5 -m-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 dark:hover:text-blue-200"
						aria-label={ "Remove " + val }
						data-tc-tag-remove={ val }
					>
						@icons.IconWithStrokeWidth(icons.X, "h-3 w-3", 2)
					</button>
				</span>
				<input type="hidden" name={ props.Name } value={ val }/>
			}
			<input
				type="text"
				id={ id }
				class="flex-1 min-w-[120px] bg-transparent border-0 outline-none py-1 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500 caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400"
				placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
				if props.Disabled {
					disabled
				}
				if props.Required {
					required
				}
				aria-label={ utils.Coalesce(props.AriaLabel, props.Label, tagsInputFallbackName) }
				data-tc-tags-input
				{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
				{ props.Attrs... }
			/>
		</div>
		if props.Error != "" {
			@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
		}
		if props.HelpText != "" {
			@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
		}
		@tagsInputScriptComponent(props.Nonce)
	</div>
}
package forms

import (

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// EnterKeyHintType defines valid HTML enterkeyhint values for the mobile
// keyboard Enter key label. See:
// https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/enterkeyhint
type EnterKeyHintType string

const (
	EnterKeyHintEnter    EnterKeyHintType = "enter"
	EnterKeyHintDone     EnterKeyHintType = "done"
	EnterKeyHintGo       EnterKeyHintType = "go"
	EnterKeyHintNext     EnterKeyHintType = "next"
	EnterKeyHintPrevious EnterKeyHintType = "previous"
	EnterKeyHintSearch   EnterKeyHintType = "search"
	EnterKeyHintSend     EnterKeyHintType = "send"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level validation set for enterkeyhint
var validEnterKeyHints = map[EnterKeyHintType]bool{
	EnterKeyHintEnter: true, EnterKeyHintDone: true, EnterKeyHintGo: true,
	EnterKeyHintNext: true, EnterKeyHintPrevious: true,
	EnterKeyHintSearch: true, EnterKeyHintSend: true,
}

// EnterKeyHintTypeIsValid returns true if v is a recognized enterkeyhint value.
func EnterKeyHintTypeIsValid(v EnterKeyHintType) bool { return validEnterKeyHints[v] }

// TextareaProps configures a textarea. AutoGrow (default true) uses the
// modern CSS field-sizing: content property to grow the textarea to fit its
// content without JavaScript. EnterKeyHint sets the mobile keyboard's Enter
// key label (e.g. "send" for chat, "done", "go", "next", "previous", "search").
type TextareaProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name         string
	Value        string
	Placeholder  string
	Label        string
	Rows         int
	Required     bool
	Disabled     bool
	ReadOnly     bool
	MaxLength    int
	AutoGrow     bool
	EnterKeyHint EnterKeyHintType
	Error        string
	HelpText     string
	Stacked      bool
}

// DefaultTextareaProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultTextareaProps() TextareaProps {
	return TextareaProps{
		Rows:     4,
		AutoGrow: true,
	}
}

// Textarea renders a labeled textarea
//
//	@forms.Textarea(forms.TextareaProps{
//	   Name: "bio",
//	   Label: "Bio",
//	   Rows: 4,
//	   Placeholder: "Tell us about yourself...",
//	})
templ Textarea(props TextareaProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: props.ID, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText, Stacked: props.Stacked}) {
		<textarea
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			if props.Placeholder != "" {
				placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
			}
			if props.Rows > 0 {
				rows={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.Rows) }
			} else {
				rows="4"
			}
			class={ utils.Class(baseInputClass(props.Error != ""), utils.Ternary(props.AutoGrow, "field-sizing-content min-h-10 max-h-80", ""), props.Class) }
			if props.EnterKeyHint != "" {
				enterkeyhint={ props.EnterKeyHint }
			}
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.ReadOnly {
				readonly
			}
			if props.MaxLength > 0 {
				maxlength={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.MaxLength) }
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			{ props.Value }
		</textarea>
	}
}
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// ToggleSize defines the size of a toggle switch
type ToggleSize string

const (
	ToggleSizeSM ToggleSize = "sm"
	ToggleSizeMD ToggleSize = "md"
	ToggleSizeLG ToggleSize = "lg"
)

// ToggleProps configures a toggle/switch input
type ToggleProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Label    string
	Checked  bool
	Disabled bool
	Required bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
	Size     ToggleSize
}

// DefaultToggleProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultToggleProps() ToggleProps {
	return ToggleProps{
		Size: ToggleSizeMD,
	}
}

// toggleSizeClasses returns the track, thumb, and checked-state move classes for each size
func toggleSizeClasses(size ToggleSize) (track, thumb, move string) {
	s := toggleSizeLookup(size)
	return s.Track, s.Thumb, s.Move
}

type toggleSizeSet struct {
	Track, Thumb, Move string
}

// Move values include the complete "peer-checked:*:" variant prefix as a
// literal so Tailwind's content scanner can detect them. Concatenating the
// variant at runtime ("peer-checked:" + x) produces an invisible token that
// the scanner never finds, so the generated CSS omits the class and the thumb
// does not slide.
//
// The move class is applied to the TRACK, not the thumb: Tailwind's
// peer-checked variant compiles to ":is(:where(.peer):checked ~ *)", which
// only matches SIBLINGS of the peer input. The thumb is nested inside the
// track, so a peer-checked class on the thumb itself can never match (the
// circle never moved). The "*" child variant reaches it:
// peer-checked:*:inset-s-N compiles to "sibling-of-checked-peer > *".
//
// The thumb moves via inset-inline-start (logical), not translate-x
// (physical): the unchecked thumb rests at inset-s-0.5, so checked must set
// the checked position 0.125rem from the inline edge
// (track − thumb − 2×0.125rem, in spacing units: 4.5/5.5/6.5). translate-x
// is physical and would push the thumb off the track's leading edge in RTL;
// inset-inline-start mirrors with dir="rtl" in both rest and checked states.
// The thumb animates its inline-start inset (CSS transition on that property).
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for toggle sizes.
var toggleSizeMap = map[ToggleSize]toggleSizeSet{
	ToggleSizeSM: {"w-9 h-5", "w-4 h-4", "peer-checked:*:inset-s-4.5"},
	ToggleSizeLG: {"w-14 h-8", "w-7 h-7", "peer-checked:*:inset-s-6.5"},
}

var toggleSizeDefault = toggleSizeSet{"w-11 h-6", "w-5 h-5", "peer-checked:*:inset-s-5.5"}

func toggleSizeLookup(size ToggleSize) toggleSizeSet {
	return utils.Lookup(toggleSizeMap, size, toggleSizeDefault)
}

// Toggle renders an accessible toggle switch
// Uses a visually-hidden checkbox for native form submission and accessibility,
// with role="switch" so screen readers announce a switch (on/off) rather than a
// checkbox (checked/unchecked). The native `switch` attribute would be cleaner
// but is Safari-only today, so role="switch" is the portable form.
//
// aria-checked is deliberately OMITTED: ARIA in HTML forbids the attribute on
// input type=checkbox (the validator rejects it), and HTML-AAM derives the
// switch state from the native checked property — the state is announced
// correctly with zero JavaScript, including across bfcache/form-history
// restores, because the browser owns the checked property.
//
//	@forms.Toggle(forms.ToggleProps{Name: "notifications", Label: "Enable notifications", Checked: true})
templ Toggle(props ToggleProps) {
	{{ trackClass, thumbClass, moveClass := toggleSizeClasses(props.Size) }}
	<label
		class={ utils.Class("flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center", utils.Ternary(props.Disabled, "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed", "cursor-pointer"), props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<input
			type="checkbox"
			role="switch"
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class="peer sr-only"
			if props.Checked {
				checked
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
		/>
		<span class={ utils.Class("relative rounded-full bg-gray-200 transition-colors peer-checked:bg-blue-600 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:peer-checked:bg-blue-500 motion-reduce:transition-none", trackClass, moveClass) }>
			<span class={ utils.Class("absolute top-0.5 inset-s-0.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-[inset-inline-start] motion-reduce:transition-none", thumbClass) }></span>
		</span>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<span class="ms-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ props.Label }</span>
		}
	</label>
	@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
	if props.HelpText != "" {
		@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
	}
}

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// FieldError represents a single field validation error
type ValidationError struct {
	Field   string // HTML element ID (e.g. "email", "user_name") — used as the anchor href target
	Message string
}

// ValidationSummaryProps configures a form validation error summary
type ValidationSummaryProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Errors []ValidationError
}

// DefaultValidationSummaryProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultValidationSummaryProps() ValidationSummaryProps {
	return ValidationSummaryProps{}
}

// ValidationSummary renders an accessible error summary for form validation
//
//	@forms.ValidationSummary(forms.ValidationSummaryProps{
//	   Errors: []forms.ValidationError{
//	     {Field: "email", Message: "Email is required"},
//	     {Field: "name", Message: "Name must be at least 2 characters"},
//	   },
//	})
templ ValidationSummary(props ValidationSummaryProps) {
	if len(props.Errors) > 0 {
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("rounded-md bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30 p-4 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800", props.Class) }
			role="alert"
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			<div class="flex">
				<div class="flex-shrink-0">
					@icons.Icon(icons.ExclamationCircle, "h-5 w-5 text-red-400 dark:text-red-500")
				</div>
				<div class="ms-3">
					<h3 class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">
						{ fmt.Sprintf("%d error%s found", len(props.Errors), utils.Ternary(len(props.Errors) == 1, "", "s")) }
					</h3>
					<div class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">
						<ul class="list-disc space-y-1 ps-5">
							for _, err := range props.Errors {
								<li>
									if err.Field != "" {
										<a href={ "#" + err.Field } class="text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 underline hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-300">{ err.Message }</a>
									} else {
										{ err.Message }
									}
								</li>
							}
						</ul>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}
package htmx

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// ErrorHandlingConfig configures the global HTMX error handling behavior
type ErrorHandlingConfig struct {
	// Nonce is the CSP nonce for inline scripts
	Nonce string
	// MaxErrorHistory is the maximum number of errors to track (default: 10)
	MaxErrorHistory int
	// MaxRetries is the maximum number of retry attempts for server errors (default: 2)
	MaxRetries int
	// RetryDelayMS is the base delay in milliseconds between retries, multiplied by retry count (default: 1000)
	RetryDelayMS int
}

// DefaultErrorHandlingConfig returns sensible defaults for error handling
func DefaultErrorHandlingConfig() ErrorHandlingConfig {
	return ErrorHandlingConfig{
		MaxErrorHistory: 10,
		MaxRetries:      2,
		RetryDelayMS:    1000,
	}
}

func (c *ErrorHandlingConfig) normalize() {
	if c.MaxErrorHistory <= 0 {
		c.MaxErrorHistory = 10
	}
	if c.MaxRetries <= 0 {
		c.MaxRetries = 2
	}
	if c.RetryDelayMS <= 0 {
		c.RetryDelayMS = 1000
	}
}

// GlobalErrorHandling renders a comprehensive global HTMX error handling script.
// Include this once in your base layout, ideally at the end of the body.
// Requires feedback.ToastContainer on the page for accessible error announcements (aria-live).
// If ToastContainer is not present, errors are only logged to the console.
//
// Typical layout wiring:
//
//	@layout.Base(layout.PageProps{...}) {
//	    @feedback.ToastContainer(nonce)  // must be present for toast error feedback
//	    // ... page content ...
//	    @htmx.GlobalErrorHandling(htmx.DefaultErrorHandlingConfig())
//	}
templ GlobalErrorHandling(cfg ErrorHandlingConfig) {
	{{ cfg.normalize() }}
	<div id="tc-error-announcer" aria-live="polite" class="sr-only"></div>
	<script { utils.ScriptAttrs(cfg.Nonce)... }>
		(function() {
			'use strict';

			var MAX_ERROR_HISTORY = {{ cfg.MaxErrorHistory }};
			var MAX_RETRIES = {{ cfg.MaxRetries }};
			var RETRY_DELAY_MS = {{ cfg.RetryDelayMS }};

			const errorHistory = [];

			// Family-aware toast type mapping
			var tcFamilyToastMap = {
				'rejection': 'warning',
				'conflict': 'warning',
				'transient': 'info',
				'corruption': 'error',
				'infrastructure': 'error',
				'orchestration': 'error'
			};

			function tcParseErrorBody(xhr) {
				if (!xhr || !xhr.responseText) return null;
				try {
					var body = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
					if (body && (body.family || body.code || body.message)) return body;
				} catch (e) {}
				return null;
			}

			function tcHandleHTMXError(event, type) {
				var xhr = event.detail.xhr;

				console.error('HTMX Error:', {
					type: type,
					status: xhr ? xhr.status : 0,
					statusText: xhr ? xhr.statusText : '',
					url: xhr ? xhr.responseURL : 'unknown',
					timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
				});

				errorHistory.unshift({
					type: type,
					status: xhr ? xhr.status : 0,
					url: xhr ? xhr.responseURL : '',
					timestamp: Date.now()
				});
				if (errorHistory.length > MAX_ERROR_HISTORY) {
					errorHistory.length = MAX_ERROR_HISTORY;
				}

				if (typeof tcShowToast === 'function') {
					var message, toastType, title;
					var structured = tcParseErrorBody(xhr);

					if (type === 'network' || !xhr || xhr.status === 0) {
						message = 'Network error. Check your connection.';
						toastType = 'error';
						title = 'Connection Lost';
					} else if (structured && structured.family) {
						message = structured.message || 'An error occurred.';
						toastType = tcFamilyToastMap[structured.family] || 'error';
						title = structured.title || (structured.code || 'Error');
						if (structured.fix) message += ' ' + structured.fix;
					} else if (xhr.status >= 500) {
						message = 'Server error. Please try again.';
						toastType = 'error';
						title = 'Server Error';
					} else if (xhr.status === 404) {
						message = 'Requested resource not found.';
						toastType = 'warning';
						title = 'Not Found';
					} else if (xhr.status === 403) {
						message = 'You do not have permission to perform this action.';
						toastType = 'warning';
						title = 'Access Denied';
					} else if (xhr.status === 401) {
						message = 'Your session has expired. Please refresh the page.';
						toastType = 'error';
						title = 'Authentication Required';
						setTimeout(function() { window.location.reload(); }, 3000);
					} else if (xhr.status >= 400) {
						message = 'Request failed. Please try again.';
						if (structured && structured.message) message = structured.message;
						toastType = 'error';
						title = structured && structured.code ? structured.code : 'Request Failed';
					} else {
						message = 'An unexpected error occurred.';
						toastType = 'error';
						title = 'Error';
					}
					tcShowToast(message, toastType, title, 5000);
				}
				var announcer = document.getElementById('tc-error-announcer');
				if (announcer) announcer.textContent = message || 'An error occurred.';
			}

			document.addEventListener('htmx:sendError', function(event) {
				tcHandleHTMXError(event, 'network');
			});

			document.addEventListener('htmx:responseError', function(event) {
				var xhr = event.detail.xhr;
				var elt = event.detail.elt;
				if (xhr && (xhr.status >= 500 || xhr.status === 0) && elt) {
					var retries = parseInt(elt.getAttribute('data-tc-retry') || '0');
					if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
						elt.setAttribute('data-tc-retry', String(retries + 1));
						setTimeout(function() {
							var triggerSpec = elt.getAttribute('hx-trigger');
							var eventName = triggerSpec ? triggerSpec.split(' ')[0].trim() : 'click';
							htmx.trigger(elt, eventName);
						}, RETRY_DELAY_MS * (retries + 1));
						return;
					}
					elt.removeAttribute('data-tc-retry');
				}
				tcHandleHTMXError(event, 'response');
			});

			document.addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function(event) {
				var xhr = event.detail.xhr;
				if (xhr && xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
					var elt = event.detail.elt;
					if (elt) elt.removeAttribute('data-tc-retry');
				}
			});

			window.htmxErrorHistory = function() { return errorHistory; };
		})();
	</script>
}
package htmx

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// SwapStyle is an HTMX swap style for out-of-band updates.
type SwapStyle string

// HTMX swap styles (https://htmx.org/attributes/hx-swap/).
const (
	SwapInnerHTML   SwapStyle = "innerHTML"
	SwapOuterHTML   SwapStyle = "outerHTML"
	SwapBeforeBegin SwapStyle = "beforebegin"
	SwapAfterBegin  SwapStyle = "afterbegin"
	SwapBeforeEnd   SwapStyle = "beforeend"
	SwapAfterEnd    SwapStyle = "afterend"
	SwapDelete      SwapStyle = "delete"
	SwapNone        SwapStyle = "none"
)

// validSwapStyles are the allowed HTMX swap styles for out-of-band updates.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level validation set
var validSwapStyles = map[SwapStyle]bool{
	SwapInnerHTML: true, SwapOuterHTML: true, SwapBeforeBegin: true,
	SwapAfterBegin: true, SwapBeforeEnd: true, SwapAfterEnd: true,
	SwapDelete: true, SwapNone: true,
}

// normalizeSwapStyle returns style if valid, otherwise falls back to outerHTML.
func normalizeSwapStyle(style SwapStyle) SwapStyle {
	if validSwapStyles[style] {
		return style
	}
	return SwapOuterHTML
}

// ConfirmDeleteProps configures a confirmation delete button.
type ConfirmDeleteProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Delete  string
	Target  string
	Confirm string
}

// ConfirmDelete renders a button with a confirmation dialog for destructive actions.
// HTMX-ONLY by design: the pinned Datastar runtime ships NO confirm machinery
// (bundle-verified 2026-10-03 — zero confirm tokens in the v0.6.1 bundle), so
// there is no wire-dialect twin. A Datastar caller that needs confirmation
// owns it consumer-side (e.g. a data-on:click__prevent handler that re-fires
// the action after its own dialog resolves).
//
//	@htmx.ConfirmDelete(htmx.ConfirmDeleteProps{Delete: "/delete/123", Target: "#item-123", Confirm: "Are you sure?"})
templ ConfirmDelete(props ConfirmDeleteProps) {
	<button
		type="button"
		class={ utils.Class("text-red-600 hover:text-red-900 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:text-red-300", props.Class) }
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		hx-delete={ props.Delete }
		hx-target={ props.Target }
		hx-swap="outerHTML"
		if props.Confirm != "" {
			hx-confirm={ props.Confirm }
		}
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		Delete
	</button>
}

// SwapOOBProps configures an out-of-band swap wrapper.
type SwapOOBProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Selector  string
	SwapStyle SwapStyle
}

// SwapOOB renders an out-of-band swap wrapper for HTMX responses.
// Use this to update multiple elements in a single response. Invalid swap
// styles fall back to outerHTML.
//
//	@htmx.SwapOOB(htmx.SwapOOBProps{Selector: "#toast-container", SwapStyle: htmx.SwapBeforeEnd}) {
//	   @feedback.Toast(props)
//	 }
templ SwapOOB(props SwapOOBProps) {
	{{ style := normalizeSwapStyle(props.SwapStyle) }}
	{{
		oobAttr := string(style)
		if props.Selector != "" {
			oobAttr += ":" + props.Selector
		}
	}}
	<div
		hx-swap-oob={ oobAttr }
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ props.Class }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
	</div>
}

templ CSRFToken(token string) {
	<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value={ token }/>
}

// defaultSpinner returns the provided spinner, or a no-op component when nil,
// so callers can safely pass a zero-value templ.Component without a render panic.
func defaultSpinner(spinner templ.Component) templ.Component {
	if spinner != nil {
		return spinner
	}
	return templ.NopComponent
}

// LoadingIndicator renders a fixed-position HTMX loading indicator.
// Accepts a spinner component for decoupled loading animation.
//
//	@htmx.LoadingIndicator(feedback.Spinner(feedback.SpinnerProps{Size: feedback.SpinnerLG, Color: "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"}))
templ LoadingIndicator(spinner templ.Component) {
	<div id="tc-loading-indicator" class="htmx-indicator fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-950/80 backdrop-blur-xs opacity-0 pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0" role="status" aria-live="polite">
		<span class="sr-only">Loading…</span>
		<div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
			@defaultSpinner(spinner)
		</div>
	</div>
}

// InlineLoadingOverlay renders a localized loading overlay for HTMX targets.
// Accepts a spinner component for decoupled loading animation.
//
//	@htmx.InlineLoadingOverlay("tc-form-loading", feedback.Spinner(feedback.SpinnerProps{Size: feedback.SpinnerMD, Color: "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"}))
templ InlineLoadingOverlay(id string, spinner templ.Component) {
	<div
		id={ id }
		class="htmx-indicator absolute inset-0 z-40 flex items-center justify-center bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-900/80 backdrop-blur-xs rounded-lg"
		role="status"
		aria-live="polite"
	>
		<span class="sr-only">Loading…</span>
		@defaultSpinner(spinner)
	</div>
}

// LoadingButton renders a button with built-in loading state.
// During an HTMX request (htmx-request on the button or an ancestor) the
// default text hides and the loading text + spinner show; at rest only the
// default text is visible. The spinner is wrapped in htmx-indicator so it is
// gated regardless of the color classes passed in. The tc-btn-loading wrapper
// is a stable hook for hx-indicator when a different indicator scope is
// needed.
//
//	<button class="btn-primary" hx-post="/save">
//	   @htmx.LoadingButton("Save", "Saving...", feedback.Spinner(feedback.SpinnerProps{Size: feedback.SpinnerSM, Color: "text-white"}))
//	</button>
templ LoadingButton(defaultText, loadingText string, spinner templ.Component) {
	<span class="tc-btn-loading">
		<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
			<span class="htmx-indicator inline-flex">
				@defaultSpinner(spinner)
			</span>
			<span class="htmx-indicator">{ loadingText }</span>
			<span class="[.htmx-request_&]:hidden">{ defaultText }</span>
		</span>
	</span>
}
package htmx

import (
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// polledLiveValue returns the aria-live value, defaulting to polite.
func polledLiveValue(live PolledLive) PolledLive {
	if PolledLiveIsValid(live) {
		return live
	}
	return PolledLivePolite
}

// polledSwapValue returns the swap style, defaulting to outerHTML.
func polledSwapValue(swap SwapStyle) SwapStyle {
	if validSwapStyles[swap] {
		return swap
	}
	return SwapOuterHTML
}

// polledEveryValue normalizes the poll interval. htmx's parseInterval only
// understands ms/s/m suffixes (and bare numbers): everything else falls
// through to parseFloat, so "1h" becomes 1 MILLISECOND — a 1ms self-poll
// storm from a natural-looking typo (hit while writing this library's own
// E2E). Hours are converted to seconds; any other string passes through
// verbatim (exotic timing stays htmx's business).
func polledEveryValue(every string) string {
	match := everyHoursRe.FindStringSubmatch(every)
	if match == nil {
		return every
	}

	hours, err := strconv.ParseFloat(match[1], 64)

	if err != nil || hours <= 0 {
		return every
	}

	return strconv.FormatFloat(hours*3600, 'f', -1, 64) + "s"
}

var everyHoursRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)h$`)

// PolledRegion renders a div that auto-refreshes its content via HTMX polling
// on an interval. The region replaces itself (hx-swap="outerHTML") on each
// poll, which means the children re-render server-side on every request.
//
// Include a "Updated HH:MM:SS" timestamp (ShowTimestamp: true) so operators
// can verify polling is active — if the timestamp freezes, polling has stalled.
//
// When Eager is set, the region renders with an aria-busy="true" busy cue
// (data-tc-polled-busy marker) and a singleton script that fires the first
// fetch once per initial-DOM region on DOMContentLoaded, then clears the
// busy cue on the first completed request (htmx:afterSwap covers successful
// self-replacement, htmx:afterRequest covers error completions) — parity
// with datastar.LiveRegion's busy cue, so screen readers wait for the fresh
// content instead of announcing the stale initial render twice.
//
// EAGER NEVER EMITS AN hx-trigger "load" TOKEN. With the default
// hx-swap="outerHTML" the region replaces ITSELF on every response; htmx
// processes each swapped-in element and fires "load" again, so
// hx-trigger="load, every Ns" on a self-replacing element is an infinite
// self-refetch loop (the 2026-09-04 DiscordSync projection-health outage).
// The eager fetch is therefore issued by the script as a one-shot htmx.ajax
// call. Regions injected after the initial page load (htmx partial swaps,
// boosted navigation) get no eager fetch and degrade to interval-only
// polling — the busy cue clears on their first interval response.
//
//	@htmx.PolledRegion(htmx.PolledRegionProps{URL: "/partials/stats", Every: "10s", Eager: true}) {
//	   @display.StatCard(display.StatCardProps{Label: "Messages", Value: "1,234"})
//	}
//
// HYBRID RENDERING CAVEAT (strings.Builder path): PolledRegion is a
// children-slot component — rendered outside a templ file (component.Render
// straight into a strings.Builder) the { children... } slot renders EMPTY,
// and an empty polled region swaps itself for the endpoint's response on
// the first tick anyway. Render PolledRegion from a real templ file whose
// children are the server-side partial (the poll endpoint should serve
// that same partial), or pass children programmatically via
// templ.WithChildren(ctx, child) before Render. See
// docs/recipes/hybrid-strings-builder-rendering.md.
templ PolledRegion(props PolledRegionProps) {
	{{
		live := polledLiveValue(props.Live)
		swap := polledSwapValue(props.Swap)
		trigger := props.Trigger
		if trigger == "" {
			// Never a "load" token here — see the EAGER doc above. Eager's
			// first fetch is fired by the busy-cue script, not by hx-trigger.
			// polledEveryValue converts "1h"-style typos that htmx would
			// parse as 1ms into seconds.
			trigger = "every " + polledEveryValue(props.Every)
		}
		eager := props.Eager && props.Trigger == ""
		nowFn := props.Now
		if nowFn == nil {
			nowFn = time.Now
		}
		updatedAt := nowFn()
		timeFormat := props.TimeFormat
		if timeFormat == "" {
			timeFormat = "15:04:05"
		}
	}}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		hx-get={ templ.SafeURL(props.URL) }
		hx-trigger={ trigger }
		hx-swap={ string(swap) }
		aria-live={ string(live) }
		if eager {
			aria-busy="true"
			data-tc-polled-busy
		}
		class={ utils.Class("", props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
		if props.ShowTimestamp {
			<div class="mt-3 flex justify-end">
				<time
					class="text-xs tabular-nums text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500"
					datetime={ updatedAt.Format(time.RFC3339) }
				>
					Updated { updatedAt.Format(timeFormat) }
				</time>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
	if eager {
		@polledRegionBusyScript(props.Nonce)
	}
}

// polledRegionBusyScript does two jobs for eager regions, both
// singleton-guarded (safe across HTMX re-renders and multiple regions on one
// page):
//
//  1. Eager one-shot: on DOMContentLoaded it issues ONE htmx.ajax fetch per
//     busy-marked region present in the initial DOM. This replaces the old
//     hx-trigger="load, ..." token, which looped infinitely under
//     hx-swap="outerHTML" (every swapped-in element re-fires "load").
//     htmx.ajax needs no processed trigger listener, so it is race-free
//     regardless of how the htmx runtime itself is loaded (inline or
//     deferred). Regions injected later are NOT eager-fired — the script
//     body never re-runs — they poll on the interval only.
//  2. Busy-cue clearing: htmx:afterSwap clears the marker on the swapped-IN
//     element (a successful outerHTML poll replaces the region, and the
//     response may re-render it busy), htmx:afterRequest clears the
//     requesting element (error completions perform no swap, so a failing
//     endpoint also un-busies the region and leaves the initial content
//     readable).
templ polledRegionBusyScript(nonce string) {
	<script { polledRegionBusyScriptAttrs(nonce)... }>
		(function() {
			'use strict';
			if (window.tcPolledBusyAttached) return;
			window.tcPolledBusyAttached = true;
			function clearBusy(el) {
				if (el && el.hasAttribute && el.hasAttribute('data-tc-polled-busy')) {
					el.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
					el.removeAttribute('data-tc-polled-busy');
				}
			}
			function fireEager(el) {
				if (!window.htmx || !el.isConnected) return;
				var url = el.getAttribute('hx-get');
				if (!url) return;
				htmx.ajax('GET', url, {
					target: el,
					swap: el.getAttribute('hx-swap') || 'outerHTML'
				});
			}
			function fireAllEager() {
				var regions = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-polled-busy]');
				for (var i = 0; i < regions.length; i++) fireEager(regions[i]);
			}
			if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
				document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fireAllEager);
			} else {
				fireAllEager();
			}
			document.addEventListener('htmx:afterSwap', function(evt) {
				clearBusy(evt.detail && evt.detail.elt);
			});
			document.addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function(evt) {
				clearBusy((evt.detail && evt.detail.elt) || evt.target);
			});
		})();
	</script>
}

	@styleComponent(props.Nonce, viewTransitionsCSS)

	}
